jobs.title: Director, AI Translation & Adoption - Data & Technology
jobs.excerpt: When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.
jobs.description:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

Parexel is in the business of improving the world’s health. We do this by providing a suite of biopharmaceutical services that help clients across the globe transform scientific discoveries into new treatments. We believe in our values, Patients First, Quality, Respect, Empowerment & Accountability.

This role will work within our innovative Data & Technology group that continues to evolve to meet business needs, fuel Parexel's growth and enable improved support for stakeholders, including customers and ultimately patients, who will benefit from Parexel's integrated processes and systems.

This role can be based in either Poland or Romania and can be fully home based and remote working anywhere in either of these two locations only.

As the Director, AI Translation & Adoption you will own the adoption posture for AI across Parexel — making sure the right AI capabilities reach the right people, in language they can use, at the right moment. You will be the connective tissue between AI Enablement and the organizations that drive change at scale: Organizational Change Management , L&D, Corporate Communications, and the Single Point Of Contact and change ambassador networks. You will lead a team that translates highly technical AI concepts into accessible, accurate, and useful information for non-technical audiences, and curates the AI education and communications calendar to match strategic priority rather than engineer availability. You will not duplicate the work of partner organizations — you will equip them to deliver AI-related change with confidence.

We are looking for someone who is deeply curious about how technology gets adopted in real organizations, and who has the rare ability to translate complex technical concepts into plain language without losing accuracy. You will be comfortable aggregating information across many sources, distilling what matters, and getting it in front of the right people at the right time. You will partner across functions, read the room, and understand that adoption happens through trust as much as through training. You will have experience working with change management, communications, or learning organizations, and know how to make those partnerships productive. You must be comfortable being the AI subject-matter authority in a room of non-technical stakeholders, and know when to lead and when to step back and let your partners do their best work.

Key Accountabilities:

AI Adoption Strategy & Curation

  • Own the AI adoption posture across Parexel: what gets emphasized, when, and to whom.

  • Curate the AI communications and education calendar to match strategic priority — not the order in which engineers happen to ask for visibility.

Translation & Liaison

  • Lead the function's work translating technical AI concepts into accessible language for non-technical audiences, while serving as the technical-accuracy check on AI messaging across Parexel.

  • Brief OCM, L&D, Corporate Communications, and the SPOC and change ambassador networks on AI direction and updates.

Education Programming

  • Oversee the AI education calendar — lunch and learns, speaker series, role-based learning paths, and topical sessions.

  • Partner with L&D on delivery infrastructure (Cornerstone, internal learning platforms).

Cross-Functional Partnerships

  • Operate as a service to partner organizations: OCM, L&D, Corporate Communications, and others bring AI-related needs to the function leader, who triages, prioritizes, and allocates the team's capacity to respond.

  • Treat that capacity as a structural commitment — partner organizations should be able to plan their AI-related work expecting the team's bandwidth, not hope for it as available.

Team Leadership

  • Lead a team responsible for adoption liaison, translation, and education programming.

  • Develop the team's AI fluency and translation skill over time.

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree required; field flexible (technical, communications, organizational psychology, or related).

  • Advanced degree in a related field preferred.

Skills:

  • Exceptional ability to translate technical concepts into accessible language for non-technical audiences.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills across formats (briefings, presentations, written content, working sessions).

  • Strong stakeholder management and partnership skills, especially with change management, communications, and learning organizations.

  • Sound judgment in curating what messages reach which audiences at what time.

  • Comfortable as the AI subject-matter authority in non-technical settings; equally comfortable deferring to subject-matter experts when appropriate.

Knowledge and Experience:

  • Strong demonstratable experience in high level roles at Director level that combine technology and communications — adoption leadership, technical product marketing, change management for technology programs, or similar.

  • Strong working knowledge of AI and generative AI concepts; able to maintain credibility with technical teams while staying accessible to non-technical audiences.

  • Experience partnering with organizational change management, learning and development, and corporate communications functions.

  • Familiarity with adoption metrics and the operational definitions of adoption (active usage, integrated workflow, demonstrated value).

  • Experience in regulated industries (life sciences, healthcare, financial services) preferred.

In return we will be able to offer you a structured career pathway and encouragement to develop within the role including awareness and understanding of the industry. You will be well supported and in return for your hard work you will be rewarded with a competitive base salary, bonus, car allowance and holiday as well as other leading benefits you would expect with a top company in the CRO Industry.

Apply today to begin your Parexel journey!

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Node)
jobs.excerpt: Role Summary The Senior Node Software Engineer is a technically senior individual contributor leading the Node sub-team's technical direction, architecture decisions, and code quality standards, while remaining deeply hands-on in the design, development, and delivery of Evry Health's frontend, mobile, and backend platform.
jobs.description:
Role Summary

The Senior Node Software Engineer is a technically senior individual contributor leading the Node sub-team's technical direction, architecture decisions, and code quality standards, while remaining deeply hands-on in the design, development, and delivery of Evry Health's frontend, mobile, and backend platform. The role is full-stack capable — designing complex Next.js API routes, Node.js backend services, and the underlying data layer as needed and bringing a system-level perspective to architecture that considers performance, security, scalability, and healthcare regulatory compliance across the full stack.

About Evry Health and Globe Life

We are on a mission to bring humanity to health insurance. Our high-technology health plans expand benefits, increase access and transparency, and feature a personalized, human approach. We strive to ensure members live happier, healthier lives.
Evry Health is the major medical division of Globe Life (NYSE:GL). Globe Life has 16.8 million policies in force, and more than 3,000 corporate employees and 15,000 agents. For more than 45 consecutive years, Globe Life has earned an A (Excellent) rating or higher from A.M. Best Company.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Node Architecture & System Design: Leads architecture of the frontend, mobile, and backend platform — component design, rendering strategy, state management, service and API structure, and relational/document data modeling — documenting decisions for stakeholders.
  • Senior-Level Feature Development: Owns design and implementation of the most complex frontend/mobile features using React, TypeScript, Next.js, and React Native, delivering production-quality code that sets the team standard.
  • Full-Stack Development — Node.js & Next.js API Layer: Designs and implements complex Next.js API routes and Node.js backend services — API design, authentication/authorization, caching, and relational/document database design and access — bridging frontend and backend.
  • Technical Leadership & Mentoring: Provides day-to-day technical leadership to the Node sub-team — leading code reviews, mentoring junior engineers, and establishing and enforcing Node coding standards.
  • Performance, Testing, & CI/CD Ownership: Owns performance optimization, testing strategy, and CI/CD pipeline governance, ensuring HIPAA-compliant, secure, and high-availability frontend and mobile applications.

Qualifications

    Required

  • Bachelor's degree in CS, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience

  • 7+ years of professional software development experience with primary frontend expertise

  • Deep, demonstrable proficiency with React, TypeScript, and Next.js in production applications

  • Senior-level React Native/Expo mobile experience and strong Node.js backend capability, including relational and document database design
    • Preferred

  • 10+ years of professional experience across frontend and full-stack development

  • Experience in healthcare technology, health insurance, or another regulated industry

  • Experience with healthcare data standards (HL7 FHIR, X12, NCPDP) as applied to frontend rendering

  • Experience with GraphQL Federation/tRPC, monorepo tooling & relational/document schema design

Telecommuting Requirements

  • This is a remote position. Our whole company works remotely. Company headquarters are in Dallas, Texas. Candidates must reside in the Eastern or Central time zones.
  • Company business hours are weekdays 9-5 CST.
  • As part of the interview process, finalists will be required to attend an in-person interview at our Dallas headquarters.
  • Required to have a dedicated work area established that is separate from other living areas and provides information privacy.
  • Ability to keep all company sensitive documents secure.
  • Must live in a location that receives an existing high-speed internet connection/service.

jobs.excerpt: About Storyous:12 years ago, Storyous started as a small start-up that supplied cafes and restaurants with the Point of Sale (POS) system on a wooden stand.
jobs.description:
About Storyous:

12 years ago, Storyous started as a small start-up that supplied cafes and restaurants with the Point of Sale (POS) system on a wooden stand. We are currently a best-in-class solution and a market leader in Czechia with a product offering that includes, POS, Menu and Table management, Inventory management, User management & Access controls, and Delivery integrations! In 2021, we teamed up with international fintech start-up Teya (formerly SaltPay), expanding our offering to also provide integrated payments solution to our customers. We continue our mission - to help entrepreneurs focus on their customers and satisfaction.

What will you do:

You will work with a diverse team to help shape the future of our Product and Engineering solution. You will be part of the whole product development lifecycle, with direct access to a wealth of customer feedback.

Your primary focus will be on our Android-based mobile apps, written in Kotlin, used in busy restaurant environments. We value developers who can contribute across the stack – whether it’s building back-end services in Node.js or PHP, working with databases like MongoDB and MariaDB, or helping integrate APIs and tools that make our platform more powerful and cohesive. As such you will be expected to contribute to end-to-end development of features.

You’ll collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver end-to-end features that are well-integrated and user-focused. You’ll take part in the full development lifecycle and benefit from fast feedback loops, continuous delivery, and a strong emphasis on product quality and maintainability.

On a regular day as a Software Engineer, you will:

  • Focus on delivering software components and improvements to your team’s software. In addition to new code, this often includes refactoring and deprecation work.

  • Write clean, secure, and well-tested code to solve business problems.

  • Build tools and integrate systems to scale the effectiveness of products across the business.

  • Collaborate and communicate effectively within the team and across the organization to achieve the team’s goals.

  • Continuously work to improve while being empathetic and considerate with others.

  • Act as a full life cycle Software Engineer, meaning be able to do code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing and release.

Requirements:

  • 3+ years of industry experience developing and shipping Android applications in Kotlin (app published to production / Play Store is an advantage)

  • Solid command of Jetpack libraries and modern Android architecture (MVVM or MVI, ViewModel, Navigation, Kotlin Coroutines and Flow); hands-on experience with Jetpack Compose

  • Experience designing and consuming REST APIs, including error handling, caching, and offline strategies (Retrofit/OkHttp, Room)

  • Experience with dependency injection (Hilt/Dagger or Koin) and modularized codebases

  • Proficiency writing unit and UI tests (JUnit, Espresso/Compose testing) and a habit of testing your own work without being asked

  • Confident with Git workflows (branching strategies, code review); familiarity with CI/CD pipelines for mobile (e.g. GitHub Actions, Bitrise, Fastlane)

  • Understanding of app performance, memory management, and debugging/profiling tools

  • Ability to work independently on medium-sized features from ticket to release, estimate work realistically, and mentor juniors through code review

  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor) as part of your daily workflow, with sound judgment about reviewing and validating AI-generated code

  • Strong communication skills, including with non-technical stakeholders

  • Fluent written and spoken English — English is the primary language of our international team, used daily in meetings, documentation, and code review

Advantage:

  • Experience with back-end development (Node.js, PHP or similar)

  • Experience with relational and/or non-relational databases (e.g., MariaDB, MongoDB)

  • Basic cloud/infrastructure experience with Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, etc.

  • Familiarity with containers and Docker

  • Experience with agile methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban

  • You can operate services that the team builds while identifying opportunities for improvements and keeping to the agreed levels of service.

  • You'll work in an AI-enabled environment: GitHub Copilot for coding, Glean for company-wide knowledge search, and access to frontier LLMs for prototyping and problem-solving. We actively invest in AI tooling and expect engineers to help shape how we use it.

Perks:

  • 26 days of Annual leave, home office, sick days

  • Benefit Plus Cafeteria

  • Frequent team events & activities in the office and outside

  • Glean AI’s internal, integrated solution for searching for information across the entire organisation using state-of-the-art LLMs

  • Access to the Elredo audiobook library

  • Possibility to travel to different offices around Europe

  • Office fruits and speciality coffee every day

  • Friendly, comfortable, and informal office environment

  • Flexible working hours if it suits you and your team

Overview

LMI is seeking a highly skilled DevSecOps Engineer to support Army Acquisition, Training, and Readiness (AT&R) in the sustainment and enhancement of the Army Contract Writing System (ACWS). ACWS is built on the Appian Platform. This position will enable secure, repeatable delivery by designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, automating infrastructure provisioning, integrating security controls, and supporting scalable cloud and containerized environments.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working across development, infrastructure, and cybersecurity disciplines and can translate evolving requirements into clean, scalable, secure technical implementations while supporting an Agile delivery environment.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines supporting ACWS application and infrastructure delivery.
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform and automation tools such as Ansible.
  • Architect and deploy AWS resources and cloud services that support secure application hosting, integration, monitoring, and operations.
  • Build and deploy secure containerized services using platforms such as OpenShift or Kubernetes.
  • Integrate security scanning, vulnerability detection, automated testing, and security gates into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Build and maintain secure container images and enforce secure configuration standards throughout development and deployment.
  • Administer and monitor containerization platforms, including maintenance, hardening, patching, storage, and service health activities.
  • Support secure deployment and operational integration of Appian-based application services within approved cloud environments.
  • Troubleshoot pipeline, deployment, infrastructure, integration, and environment issues and drive problems to resolution.
  • Collaborate with application developers, Appian specialists, information assurance personnel, database administrators, and system architects to align delivery with program objectives.
  • Enforce applicable DoD cybersecurity controls, including RMF, NIST SP 800-53, and STIG requirements, throughout build and deployment activities.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, including pipeline diagrams, playbooks, system configuration records, and operational procedures.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement of development, deployment, and operational practices.

Qualifications

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • 6+ years of experience supporting DevOps, DevSecOps, cloud engineering, systems automation, or related enterprise technology roles.
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes.
  • Experience deploying and operating AWS or comparable cloud solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with container technologies such as Docker and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes or OpenShift.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools and configuration automation.
  • Familiarity with security automation, vulnerability scanning, and integrating security controls into software delivery pipelines.
  • Experience working in Agile software development or enterprise operations environments.
  • Active Secret clearance or ability to obtain and maintain one.
  • U.S. citizenship required.

DESIRED SKILLS

  • Experience with the Appian Platform, including Appian Cloud or Appian GovCloud environments, preferred.
  • Terraform or Ansible experience or certification.
  • CompTIA Security+, Linux+, or comparable cybersecurity/Linux certification.
  • AWS certification such as Solutions Architect, SysOps Administrator, DevOps Engineer, or Security.
  • Experience with Git-based development workflows, Tekton, GitLab CI, or comparable CI/CD tooling.
  • Experience with BASH, Python, or Java scripting/programming.
  • Experience applying NIST SP 800-53, RMF, or STIG requirements to cloud and DevSecOps environments.
  • SAFe or Agile DevOps certification and experience supporting PI Planning or similar delivery events.

Target salary range: $100,000 - 166,000

jobs.title: Senior Database Architect
jobs.excerpt: We are seeking a Senior Database Architect who combines deep expertise in legacy database systems with forward-looking vision for AI-native data architecture.
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Senior Database Architect who combines deep expertise in legacy database systems with forward-looking vision for AI-native data architecture. You'll lead the decomposition of complex stored procedures while simultaneously designing the vector databases, embedding strategies, and semantic models that power our AI agents and workflows.

This is an AI-first role in two senses: you'll leverage AI to accelerate your own work (stored procedure analysis, migration generation, schema documentation), and you'll design the data infrastructure that AI systems depend on. If you're excited about both solving hard legacy database problems and architecting the data layer for AI-native applications, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

Legacy Database Modernization

  • Analyze and decompose large SQL Server stored procedures (1,000+ lines) with embedded business logic, creating migration strategies that extract logic into domain services

  • Design patterns for separating business rules from data access, enabling stored procedures to become thin data-access layers while business logic moves to application services

  • Lead refactoring efforts that align database structures with domain-driven design: bounded contexts, aggregates, and domain events

  • Implement event-driven patterns that decouple systems from direct database dependencies: change data capture, outbox patterns, event sourcing where appropriate

  • Optimize query performance, indexing strategies, and execution plans as part of modernization efforts

  • Create migration playbooks and tooling that engineering teams can apply to their own stored procedure modernization

AI Data Infrastructure & Semantic Modeling

  • Design semantic data models that capture domain knowledge in structures optimized for AI retrieval and reasoning

  • Architect vector database solutions for RAG implementations: embedding strategies, chunking approaches, similarity search optimization, and hybrid retrieval patterns

  • Design and implement embedding pipelines that transform domain content into vector representations suitable for AI agent consumption

  • Establish knowledge graph patterns where appropriate: entity relationships, ontologies, and graph-based retrieval for complex domain reasoning

  • Define data architectures for AI agent context: what data agents need, how it's structured, how freshness and consistency are maintained

  • Design evaluation frameworks for RAG quality: retrieval accuracy, relevance scoring, and feedback loops for continuous improvement

Modern Data Platform Architecture

  • Design canonical data models and schemas that are flexible, extensible, and aligned with business domain concepts

  • Architect data solutions across multiple platforms: SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB/Cosmos DB, Snowflake, and vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, Azure AI Search)

  • Design event-driven data flows: Kafka-based event streaming, materialized views, CQRS patterns, and real-time data synchronization

  • Establish data platform infrastructure patterns: data pipelines, ETL/ELT orchestration, data quality frameworks, and observability

  • Define data residency, partitioning, and multi-region strategies for performance and compliance

  • Create reference architectures for common data patterns that domain teams can adopt

AI-First Database Engineering

  • Leverage AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) to accelerate stored procedure analysis, refactoring, and migration

  • Build AI-powered tools for database engineering: automated stored procedure analysis, schema documentation generators, migration assistants, and query optimization recommenders

  • Create AI-consumable artifacts: structured documentation, annotated schemas, and context files that enable AI agents to understand and work with database systems

  • Author database architecture skills that encode patterns, constraints, and best practices for AI-assisted development

  • Develop prompts, workflows, and tooling that help engineering teams apply AI effectively to database modernization tasks

Cross-Domain Leadership

  • Partner with AI/ML teams to ensure data architecture supports agent and workflow requirements

  • Collaborate with domain teams to understand their data requirements and design solutions aligned with domain ownership

  • Work with application architects to ensure data architecture supports service-oriented and event-driven designs

  • Contribute to Enterprise Architecture Council (EAC) standards for data architecture, modeling conventions, and technology selection

  • Mentor engineers on database design, optimization, semantic modeling, and AI data infrastructure

What You'll Bring

Required Experience

  • 8–12 years in database engineering and architecture, with significant experience in enterprise-scale SQL Server environments

  • Deep SQL Server expertise: T-SQL optimization, stored procedure design and refactoring, query plan analysis, indexing strategies, and performance tuning

  • Hands-on modernization experience: track record of decomposing complex stored procedures and migrating business logic to application services

  • Multi-platform data architecture: experience designing solutions across relational (SQL Server, PostgreSQL), NoSQL (MongoDB, Cosmos DB), and analytical (Snowflake, data lakehouse) platforms

  • Event-driven data patterns: CDC, Kafka, outbox pattern, event sourcing, CQRS—practical experience implementing these in production

  • Data modeling expertise: canonical models, dimensional modeling, schema evolution, and designing for extensibility

AI & Semantic Data Competencies

  • Vector database experience: hands-on with at least one vector DB (Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, pgvector, Azure AI Search, or similar)

  • RAG architecture understanding: embedding models, chunking strategies, retrieval optimization, hybrid search, and reranking patterns

  • Semantic modeling: experience designing data structures optimized for AI retrieval—knowledge representation, ontologies, or domain-specific schemas for AI consumption

  • Understanding of embedding pipelines: text preprocessing, embedding generation, vector indexing, and incremental updates

  • Familiarity with LLM context requirements: what data AI agents need, token constraints, context window optimization

AI-Native Engineering Practices

  • 2+ years actively using AI coding assistants for database work; deep understanding of how to prompt effectively for SQL and data engineering tasks

  • Experience building tools, scripts, or automation that leverage AI/LLM capabilities

  • Familiarity with structured artifact creation for AI consumption: documented schemas, annotated procedures, context files

  • Vision for AI-assisted database engineering and ability to build tooling that enables it

Technical Depth

  • Strong programming skills in at least one backend language (C#, Java, Python) for building migration tooling, embedding pipelines, and services

  • Cloud data services experience: Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Azure AI Search, Azure Synapse, Snowflake, or AWS equivalents

  • Infrastructure-as-code for data platforms: Terraform, ARM/Bicep, or CloudFormation

  • Understanding of domain-driven design and how data architecture supports bounded contexts

  • Familiarity with data governance, lineage, and compliance requirements (HIPAA, PCI-DSS)

Preferred Experience

  • Background in healthcare, benefits, payments, or similarly regulated industries

  • Experience building RAG systems or AI-powered search/retrieval applications

  • Knowledge graph experience: Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, or similar graph databases

  • Contributions to database tooling, AI/ML data infrastructure, or open-source projects

  • Experience mentoring engineers or leading database/data architecture communities of practice

The base pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the pay range for this position. Actual pay rates will vary and will be based on various factors, such as your qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. Base pay is one component of WEX's total compensation package. Most sales positions are eligible for commission under the terms of an applicable plan. Non-sales roles are typically eligible for a quarterly or annual bonus based on their role and applicable plan. jobs.description:
Mindrift is looking for a highly skilled Presentation Designer to join the Tendem project (**) and create high-quality presentations for real-world use cases. In this role, you'll apply your expertise in visual communication, information design, and storytelling to create clear, engaging, and professionally designed presentations. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for creative professionals with hands-on experience in visual communications, information design, and storytelling.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Presentation Designer, you will focus on storytelling and visual hierarchy. We need a specialist who knows how to communicate complex information beautifully, turning raw data and narratives into compelling, highly persuasive slides and one-pagers. You will use tools such as PowerPoint, Keynote, Adobe Creative Suite, and Figma to create polished, presentation-ready deliverables.

Apply, pass qualification(s), and start contributing to projects aligned with your expertise — on your own schedule.

Candidates must have a strong portfolio featuring high-end presentations, pitch decks, and data visualization (not just basic templates). A methodical, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work independently to transform complex narratives into premium visuals are essential.

Additional requirements

  • Hands-on experience creating high-end, premium corporate-meets-creative style layouts.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $50 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Pediatrics Admin & Front Office Support

Remote | Pediatrics | Part-Time, 30 hours/week initially | $5-$6/hour
Target Start Date: September 14, 2026
Future Schedule: Expected to increase to approximately 40 hours/week as the practice opens and patient volume grows

About the Role

We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and adaptable Virtual Medical Assistant to support a growing pediatric practice during its pre-opening and early growth stages.

This is not a traditional, narrowly defined Medical VA position. During the startup phase, you will work closely with the physician as an administrative and personal assistant, helping coordinate meetings, calendars, vendors, projects, communications, and clinic setup activities.

As the practice begins seeing patients, your responsibilities will gradually transition toward front-office and medical administrative support, including scheduling, patient intake, insurance verification, and patient communication.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working in a growing environment where priorities can change, takes ownership without needing constant reminders, and can independently identify what needs to be done next.

Key Responsibilities

1. Executive, Administrative & Calendar Support

  • Manage and organize the physician's calendars, ensuring meetings, deadlines, agendas, links, documents, and preparation materials are consolidated in one place.

  • Attend administrative and vendor meetings as needed, take clear notes, document action items, and help ensure important follow-ups are completed.

  • Serve as a proactive accountability partner by tracking deadlines, projects, tasks, and outstanding items without requiring constant reminders.

2. Front Office & Patient Communication

  • Manage incoming patient calls, emails, texts, voicemails, and initial inquiries professionally once the clinic begins accepting patients.

  • Assist prospective and existing families with scheduling, follow-ups, basic questions, and other front-office communication needs.

  • Provide a warm, professional first point of contact that reflects the patient-centered experience expected from a pediatric practice.

3. Patient Scheduling, Intake & Registration

  • Coordinate end-to-end patient scheduling, including new patient appointments, follow-ups, rescheduling, and appointment-related communication.

  • Support patient intake and check-in by ensuring required demographic, administrative, and insurance information is collected accurately.

  • Maintain organized patient information and appointment records within eClinicalWorks (eCW) while following established clinic workflows.

4. Insurance Verification & Administrative Support

  • Verify commercial insurance coverage and determine whether patient insurance plans are active, pending, or require additional follow-up.

  • Complete insurance eligibility and benefit verification before appointments and document findings accurately for the practice.

  • Assist with insurance-related administrative tasks and potentially prior authorizations as clinic processes expand.

5. Vendor, Research & Project Coordination

  • Research vendors, clinic equipment, software, and other operational needs and compare available options based on cost, features, and suitability.

  • Organize research findings, pricing comparisons, project updates, and recommendations using spreadsheets and other tracking tools.

  • Follow up with vendors and internal stakeholders to keep clinic setup projects progressing according to established timelines.

6. Process Documentation & SOP Development

  • Document recurring workflows and administrative processes as the clinic develops its operating procedures.

  • Create clear step-by-step SOPs for tasks such as scheduling, patient communication, insurance verification, and other recurring activities.

  • Continuously identify opportunities to organize, standardize, and improve workflows as the practice grows.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with eClinicalWorks (eCW) is REQUIRED. Candidates without prior eCW experience should not be considered.

  • 1+ years previous experience as a Medical Virtual Assistant, Medical Assistant, Healthcare Administrative Assistant, or similar healthcare support professional.

  • Strong administrative, organizational, calendar-management, and task-management skills.

  • Excellent written and spoken English with the confidence to communicate professionally with patients, families, vendors, and healthcare professionals.

  • Strong spreadsheet skills and the ability to organize information, research, projects, and workflows independently.

  • Highly proactive and able to recognize what needs attention without waiting to be reminded.

  • Comfortable working in a startup-style environment where responsibilities and priorities may evolve.

  • Able to multitask effectively while maintaining strong attention to detail.

  • Comfortable using required secure networks, clinic systems, and productivity tracking software.

Strongly Preferred

  • Previous experience working in pediatrics.

  • Experience performing commercial insurance verification.

  • Experience handling prior authorizations for commercial insurance or HMO plans.

  • Experience supporting a physician, clinic owner, executive, or small medical practice.

  • Basic Canva or graphic-editing skills for simple social media or clinic content.

Tools & Systems

Candidates may work with:

  • eClinicalWorks (eCW) EMR, REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

  • RingRX or similar HIPAA-compliant phone systems

  • Google Calendar or other multi-calendar systems

  • Google Sheets or similar spreadsheet tools

  • Canva

  • Secure private networks/VPNs

  • Productivity tracking software

What Success Looks Like

You will succeed in this role if you become someone the physician can trust to take ownership of responsibilities, anticipate what needs to happen next, and keep important tasks from falling through the cracks.

You should be able to work independently, organize competing priorities, communicate professionally with families, and help create systems that allow the physician to focus more heavily on patient care.

As the practice grows, success will also mean helping create a smooth patient experience from the first phone call through scheduling, intake, insurance verification, and ongoing follow-up.

You will architect and ship pipelines that transform unstructured creative assets and ad performance data into a semantic, vector-based layer — and expose it through AI agents and a polished React frontend. We move fast, ship to production, and hold a high bar for craft and reliability.

  • A dual-mode data ingestion engine handling creative components (CTAs, headers, body copy, images, video, and metadata) and ad performance data (channel-level signals tied to those components)

  • AI agent tooling that enables natural language search, comparison, and reasoning across the creative and performance data layer

  • A React frontend that lets users explore the creative library, query performance data in plain English, and surface actionable optimisation insights

  • Audit-logged decisioning and governance infrastructure to meet enterprise-grade requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and build durable, idempotent ingestion pipelines for creative and performance data at scale (queues, retries, backpressure, dedup, schema evolution)

  • Generate and manage embeddings for multi-modal creative assets; select and operate the right vector store for the workload

  • Build and maintain retrieval pipelines that serve AI agent tools with accurate, low-latency responses

  • Ship agent-style systems with tool use, state management, and multi-step reasoning workflows

  • Develop and maintain the React frontend for the creative intelligence library and query interface

  • Own the full lifecycle of your systems: design, build, deploy, monitor, and iterate

  • Contribute to stack decisions with clear reasoning grounded in production experience

  • Collaborate closely with product and enterprise partners to translate requirements into reliable, scalable systems

Required Qualifications

  • Strong TypeScript — you use types as a design tool, not a formality

  • Production experience with serverless or edge runtimes (Cloudflare Workers, Vercel, Lambda, Deno Deploy, or equivalent)

  • Demonstrated experience building durable, idempotent ingestion pipelines with queuing, retry logic, backpressure handling, deduplication, and schema evolution

  • Practical, production-level understanding of embeddings, chunking strategies, and retrieval quality tuning

  • At least one agent-style system shipped to production: tool use, stateful multi-step workflows — framework matters less than the experience

  • React fluency with modern patterns and component architecture

  • Comfort operating across two cloud environments; able to reason clearly about when to use edge compute vs. managed data/AI services, and how to bridge them

  • Must have prior remote work experience, be fluent with remote collaboration tools and platforms (such as Slack, Zoom, Google Workspace, Linear, or similar), and have ideally worked with US or UK-based companies. Applications without this experience will not be considered.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building or operating RAG systems in production

  • Familiarity with current embedding models and the tradeoffs across dimension, quality, and cost

  • Background in ETL design, observability for data pipelines, or evaluation frameworks for retrieval quality

  • Adtech, performance marketing, or marketing analytics background — understanding what channels, attribution, and creative testing look like in a live production context

  • Opinions on vector databases (Cloudflare Vectorize, Vertex AI Vector Search, Turbopuffer, or similar) backed by hands-on experience

Tools & Technology

  • TypeScript (primary language across the stack)

  • Cloudflare Workers, Queues, and Agents SDK (or equivalent edge runtime)

  • GCP — Vertex AI for embeddings and related data/AI services

  • Vector database (to be selected: Cloudflare Vectorize, Vertex AI Vector Search, Turbopuffer, or similar)

  • React with Remix or TanStack Start (TBD)

  • Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, and standard remote collaboration tooling

jobs.excerpt: Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

  • A Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science / Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics / Natural Language Processing (NLP), Information Systems or other related fields.
  • Bachelor’s degree is accepted if only candidate has 5 years of experience in the field.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in related roles or domain - specifically for QA-automation/testing or cybersecurity roles

How it works
Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation:
Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $50/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio. - Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

jobs.description:
Group 1001is a consumer-centric, technology-driven family of insurance companies on a mission to deliver outstanding value and operational performance by combining financial strength and stability with deep insurance expertise and a can-do culture. Group1001’s culture emphasizes the importance of collaboration, communication, core business focus, risk management, and striving for outcomes. This goal extends to how we hire and onboard our most valuable assets – our employees.

Why This Role Matters:

The Production Operations Lead is responsible for the day-to-day operational leadership of a Prod Ops squad supporting the stability, availability, and reliability of Group 1001's production systems. This role serves as the primary escalation point within the team, coordinating incident response across multiple engineering teams, facilitating problem management to root cause resolution, and ensuring change management processes are followed consistently. The Production Operations Lead guides and mentors Production Operations Analysts, ensuring effective triage, ticketing, escalation, and stakeholder communication during service-impacting events.

The Production Operations Lead is accountable for operational outcomes: SLA adherence, notification cadence, shift handoff quality, and process compliance. This role bridges the gap between technical engineering teams and business stakeholders — translating incident impact into clear executive communication while keeping technical responders focused on resolution. An effective Production Operations Lead will demonstrate the ability to manage high-severity incident bridges, enforce escalation timelines, drive post-incident root cause analysis to completion, and build trust with cross-functional teams through consistent process execution.

How You'll Contribute:

The Production Operations Lead is expected to have deep familiarity with ITIL-aligned Incident, Problem, and Change Management processes in a highly SLA-driven environment. This role requires a solid understanding of monitoring and observability tools (Grafana, Datadog, CloudWatch, PagerDuty) with the ability to correlate alerts with potential service impacts and guide the team through rapid triage and escalation. The Production Operations Lead coordinates incident bridges for P0/P1/P2 events — facilitating the technical response, managing stakeholder notifications per defined cadence, and enforcing escalation SLAs (30-minute no-progress rule for P1, immediate executive notification for P0).

Beyond incident response, this role owns the problem management lifecycle: creating problem tickets within 24–48 hours of incident resolution, facilitating Problem Review Board (PRB) meetings to produce root cause analysis documentation, coordinating After Action Reviews (AARs) within one week, and tracking corrective actions to closure through a 30-day monitoring period. The Production Operations Lead also represents Prod Ops at the Change Advisory Board (CAB), reviewing changes for risk, providing operability sign-off when changes affect monitoring or alerting, and ensuring customer-facing communication requirements are met.

The Production Operations Lead works primarily during business hours but must be available for escalation during critical incidents and participates in on-call rotation as needed to support 24/7 operational coverage.

Main Accountabilities:

  • Serve as Incident Manager for P0/P1/P2 production incidents — spin up bridges, coordinate technical responders, enforce escalation timelines, and deliver stakeholder notifications per defined cadence
  • Assign, prioritize, and oversee BAU (day-to-day) operational work across the squad — including access requests, runbook updates, monitoring tuning, and operational maintenance
  • Guide and mentor Production Operations Analysts (Level I and II), ensuring effective triage, documentation, escalation, and communication during incidents
  • Facilitate Problem Review Board (PRB) meetings within 48 hours of incident resolution and drive root cause analysis to completion
  • Coordinate After Action Reviews (AARs) within one week of significant incidents, ensuring corrective actions are assigned with owners and due dates
  • Identify recurring incident patterns and proactively create problem tickets when thresholds are met (3+ incidents, same system, within 30 days)
  • Represent Prod Ops at the Change Advisory Board (CAB) — review changes for risk, validate implementation plans, and provide operability sign-off for changes affecting monitoring, alerting, or escalation paths
  • Enforce customer-facing communication requirements (2 business day stakeholder notice after approval) and year-end freeze policies
  • Ensure shift handoff quality — incoming shifts receive full context on active incidents, ongoing changes, and outstanding action items
  • Maintain squad-level KPIs: incident response times, notification compliance, change success rate, and problem RCA completion within SLA
  • Serve as the primary Prod Ops liaison for assigned platform or business unit, building relationships with engineering leads, app owners, and business stakeholders
  • Lead monthly proactive alert reviews with SRE to identify systemic issues before they escalate to major incidents
  • Validate operational readiness for new services onboarding to production — ensuring monitoring, alerting, runbooks, and escalation paths exist before go-live
  • Participate in post-incident reviews to improve response processes and update Method & Procedure documentation

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in a related technical discipline, or the equivalent combination of education, technical certifications or training, or work experience
  • 5+ years of experience in IT operations, NOC, or production support environments
  • 2+ years in a lead, senior, or supervisory capacity within an operations team
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating incident response across multiple teams, including bridge facilitation and stakeholder communication
  • Strong understanding of ITIL processes — specifically Incident, Problem, and Change Management
  • Experience with ITSM/ticketing platforms (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or equivalent)
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Grafana, Datadog, CloudWatch, PagerDuty, or similar)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to produce concise executive-level status updates and facilitate focused technical bridges simultaneously
  • Proven ability to work effectively under pressure, particularly during high-severity incidents requiring rapid decision-making and clear communication
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent incidents, problems, and operational tasks
  • Ability to mentor and develop team members while maintaining operational accountability

Preferred Qualifications:

  • ITIL v4 Foundation certification (or higher)
  • Experience in financial services, insurance, or other regulated industries
  • Familiarity with SLO/SLI frameworks, error budget policies, and reliability engineering principles
  • Experience with Jira workflow configuration and operational reporting
  • Background in cloud infrastructure environments (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Experience onboarding new teams or platforms into operational support models
  • Familiarity with SOC 2 compliance requirements as they relate to incident and change management

Compensation: 

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several U.S. geographic markets. The base pay for this position ranges from $140,000/year in our lowest geographic market up to $170,000/year plus bonus in our highest geographic market. Pay is based on a number of factors including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Benefits Highlights:

Employees who meet benefit eligibility guidelines and work 30 hours or more weekly, have the ability to enroll in Group 1001’s benefits package. Employees (and their families) are eligible to participate in the Company’s comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plan options. Employees are also eligible for Basic and Supplemental Life Insurance, Short and Long-Term Disability. All employees (regardless of hours worked) have immediate access to the Company’s Employee Assistance Program and wellness programs—no enrollment is required. Employees may also participate in the Company’s 401K plan, with matching contributions by the Company.

Group 1001, and its affiliated companies, is strongly committed to providing a supportive work environment where employee differences are valued. Diversity is an essential ingredient in making Group 1001 a welcoming place to work and is fundamental in building a high-performance team. Diversity embodies all the differences that make us unique individuals. All employees share the responsibility for maintaining a workplace culture of dignity, respect, understanding and appreciation of individual and group differences.

Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

  • A Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science / Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics / Natural Language Processing (NLP), Information Systems or other related fields.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in related roles or domain - specifically for QA-automation/testing or cybersecurity roles

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation:
Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $30/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

  • A Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science / Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics / Natural Language Processing (NLP), Information Systems or other related fields.
  • Bachelor’s degree is accepted if only candidate has 5 years of experience in the field.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in related roles or domain - specifically for QA-automation/testing or cybersecurity roles

How it works
Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation:
Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $40/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.

About the Role

We are seeking a Staff Product Designer (P5) who can lead high-impact product design work across multiple teams, connect adjacent product experiences and turn complex problem spaces into coherent shipped outcomes. You have spent 8+ years designing complex digital products, ideally including SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy, AI-enabled or similarly sophisticated product experiences.

As a staff individual contributor, you will operate across product areas where the right solution depends on more than one roadmap, team or feature brief. You will partner deeply with Product, Engineering, Data, Research, Design leadership and customer-facing teams to frame the right problems, define product experience direction and help teams move from ambiguity to high-quality execution.

This role requires exceptional craft, strong product judgment and the ability to balance strategic influence with hands-on design work. You should be comfortable defining experience direction, mapping complex workflows, prototyping new interaction models, strengthening shared patterns and helping teams preserve quality through implementation.

Design systems are an important part of this role, but not the whole role. You will use systems, patterns, accessibility standards and reusable components to connect product experiences while still leading original, customer-centered design work for high-impact product areas.

Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis or workflow acceleration is mandatory. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

What You'll Do

  • Lead design strategy and execution for complex initiatives that span multiple teams, product surfaces or customer workflows

  • Translate customer needs, business goals, technical constraints, data signals and product strategy into clear experience direction

  • Partner with product and engineering leaders to clarify problem spaces, sequence design work and align teams around high-quality outcomes

  • Create prototypes, workflows, interaction models and high-fidelity designs that make complex product ideas tangible and testable

  • Identify product experience gaps, design debt and cross-team inconsistencies, then turn them into practical improvements

  • Shape AI-enabled workflows, intelligent interfaces and automation-heavy experiences that give customers clarity, control and confidence

  • Strengthen shared patterns, design-system adoption, accessibility standards and implementation guidance across adjacent product areas

  • Mentor senior and lead designers through critique, coaching, product judgment, storytelling and strong design rationale

  • Collaborate effectively across US and India time zones in a 100% remote environment

What We Are Looking For

  • 8+ years of relevant product design experience, leading complex, ambiguous and high-impact initiatives across multiple teams or product areas

  • An exceptional portfolio that demonstrates staff-level craft, product judgment, customer empathy, systems thinking, measurable impact and shipped product quality

  • Experience shaping product direction beyond a single feature or team, with the ability to connect adjacent workflows into coherent customer experiences

  • Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility, content quality and implementation detail

  • Proven experience across the design lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content strategy and usability testing

  • Strong prototyping fluency, including the ability to use Figma, Framer, AI coding tools or lightweight front-end code to make complex ideas tangible

  • Experience designing AI-powered, automation-heavy or intelligent product experiences where customers need transparency, control, trust and useful guidance

  • Deep fluency in design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, data partners, customer-facing teams, senior stakeholders and other designers

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to align teams through customer insight, business rationale, data, prototypes and craft

  • A collaborative, low-ego leadership style with a track record of mentoring designers, improving critique and raising standards

How You Work

  • You move comfortably between product strategy, customer insight, systems thinking, prototyping and hands-on design execution

  • You lead through influence, clarity and credibility across teams that may not report into the same roadmap or operating rhythm

  • You are a maker as well as a strategist, using prototypes, AI-assisted tools and practical technical fluency to make ideas concrete quickly

  • You balance speed, detail, scalability and quality without losing sight of the customer

  • You build trust through warmth, candor, accountability and genuine respect for your teammates as people

  • You enjoy leading collaboration across time zones and cultural contexts, including with US- and India-based teammates

  • You communicate in ways that help distributed teams work with clarity, care, trust and momentum

  • You advocate for accessibility, inclusion and ethical design

jobs.description:
FORTNA partners with the world’s leading brands to transform omnichannel and parcel distribution operations. Known world-wide for enabling companies to keep pace with digital disruption and growth objectives, we design and deliver solutions, powered by intelligent software, to optimize fast, accurate and cost-effective order fulfillment and last mile delivery. Our Team. Our Passion. Our Approach.

Position Summary

The QueueSpecialistis an individual contributor responsible for the day-to-day performance of the support ticket queue within the Customer Service organization. The role maintains visibility into queue health, service-level performance, workload distribution, case quality, and timely routing and escalation across all priorities.

The QueueSpecialstmonitors real-time and interval ticket performance, coordinates workload adjustments with support leaders and technical teams, and drives follow-up when ticket service levels are at risk. The role partners with Incident Management, Technical Support, subject matter experts, and leadership to improve routing, accelerate ticket progression, and prevent backlogs from stagnating.

This position has no direct reports. Success depends on strong operational judgment, data analysis, clear communication, and the ability to influence timely action across teams without formal people-management authority.

Key Responsibilities

1. Queue Performance & Operational Coverage

  • Monitor ticket queue performance throughout the day and identify emergingservice-level, capacity, and coverage risks.

  • Coordinate with support leaders and technical teams to rebalance workload, adjust routing, and address volume spikes, absences, and major incidents.

  • Track staffing coverage and agent availability against demand and promptly communicate gaps or schedule risks to the appropriate leaders.

  • Maintain queue operating procedures, prioritization rules, routing standards, escalation paths, and customer communication requirements.

  • Drive follow-up on unassigned, aging, stalled, or at-risk work until ownership and next actions are confirmed.

  • Provide real-time operational guidance and recommendations without direct supervisory or performance-management responsibility.

2. Ticket Queue Management & Case Progression

  • Maintain operational visibility into ticket volume, unassigned work, backlog, aging, severity mix, assignment status, SLA performance, and customer update compliance.

  • Prioritize P1/P2 incidents, aging P3/P4 tickets, stalled cases, repeat contacts, reopened tickets, and work at risk of breaching service commitments.

  • Coordinate ticket assignment and rebalancing based on priority, skill, workload, geography, customer impact, and coverage.

  • Review tickets for complete issue details, business impact, troubleshooting history, evidence, ownership, status, and next-update commitments.

  • Conduct daily queue reviews and coordinate corrective action when progress, documentation, ownership, or customer communication does not meet standards.

  • Identify and help resolve assignment gaps, duplicate tickets, routing errors, workflow failures, and other barriers to timely case progression.

3. Escalation, Communication & Operational Coordination

  • Serve as the operational coordination point for queue risk, ownership gaps, priority questions, and cross-functional follow-up.

  • Ensure urgent and high-impact issues are escalated promptly to Incident Management, Technical Support, subject matter experts, or leadership using defined criteria.

  • Apply warm-handoff standards covering priority, impact, symptoms, timeline, diagnostics, evidence,current status, customer expectations, and next action.

  • Provide concise operational reporting on ticket backlog, SLA risk, coverage, escalations, and major service events.

  • Monitor customer update commitments and coordinate follow-up when communications are overdue or incomplete.

  • Represent queue operations in service reviews, post-incident reviews, and improvement initiatives as requested.

4. Performance Monitoring & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor compliance with ticket workflows, SLAs, escalation requirements, documentation standards, and audit expectations.

  • Track and report measures such as first-contact resolution, ticket response time, backlog aging, reopen rate, update compliance, quality scores, and customer satisfaction.

  • Coordinate corrective and preventive actions with process owners, technical teams, and stakeholders and track improvements through measurable outcomes.

  • Recommend tools, automation, routing, workflow, self-service, and coverage improvements that increase responsiveness and customer experience.

  • Strong knowledge of incident prioritization, ticket lifecycle management, routing, documentation, escalation, and customer communication.

  • Ability to interpret ticket and operational metrics, identify trends and service risks, and recommend corrective actions.

  • Experience using case-management, reporting, and knowledge-management platforms.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence action across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Sound judgment under pressure and the ability to make timely operational decisions during high-volume periods and critical incidents.

  • Strong organizational, analytical, conflict-resolution, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and maintain attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.

  • Ability to support nights, weekends, holidays, and non-traditional schedules as operational needs require.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in information technology, business, communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

  • ITIL, HDI, contact-center, or workforce-management certification.

jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

  • A Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science / Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics / Natural Language Processing (NLP), Information Systems or other related fields.
  • Bachelor’s degree is accepted if only candidate has 5 years of experience in the field.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in related roles or domain - specifically for QA-automation/testing or cybersecurity roles

How it works
Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation:
Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $50/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio. - Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

We're looking for a Senior GenAI Engineer to design and ship production-grade AI systems that touch millions of users across the buying and selling journey.

What You’ll Do

  • Architect production GenAI systems across multiple domains, including conversational agents, automated order and dispute workflows, personalized discovery and recommendations, content generation, search relevance, and emerging use cases.

  • Build the retrieval and embeddings stack, including chunking strategies, embedding model selection, vector indexes, hybrid search, reranking, and retrieval evaluation pipelines.

  • Make it reliable and cost-efficient through streaming, prompt caching, latency budgets, token cost optimization, observability for LLM calls, and graceful fallback when models or upstreams misbehave.

  • Establish evaluation rigor with offline and online evals covering response quality, tool call correctness, hallucination rate, retrieval precision, and business KPIs.

  • Drive experimentation and research by evaluating new models, frameworks, and agent patterns, running focused experiments, and bringing what works into production.

  • Mentor and raise the bar for engineers across the team on AI and ML best practices, prompt engineering, and production readiness.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Data, Ops, and CX to identify high-leverage AI opportunities and ship them.

Where You'll Have Impact

    A non-exhaustive list of areas we are actively building in or want to:

    • Conversational AI for customer support, dispute resolution, and seller assistance

    • Automated order handling, escalation routing, and workflow orchestration

    • Personalized discovery, recommendations, and search relevance

    • Listing quality, including auto-generated titles, descriptions, categorization, and image understanding

    • Trust and safety, including fraud signals, anomaly detection, and content moderation

    • Internal agent tooling for ops and CX teams

Qualifications

    Required
    • 5+ years building production software, with at least 2 years shipping LLM and ML-powered features at scale.
    • Strong Python for backend services, scripting, data pipelines, and ML tooling.
    • Working ability in TypeScript and React for integrating AI features directly into product surfaces.
    • Production experience with major LLM providers (Gemini, Claude, GPT) covering tool and function calling, structured outputs, streaming, prompt caching, and cost control.
    • Deep understanding of Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG): document ingestion, chunking, embedding generation, vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, or similar), hybrid retrieval, and reranking.
    • Solid grounding in embeddings and vector search: dense vs. sparse representations, similarity metrics, indexing strategies (HNSW, IVF), and dimensionality tradeoffs.
    • Strong ML and NLP fundamentals: transformer architectures, tokenization, fine-tuning vs. prompting tradeoffs, classification, ranking, and evaluation methodology.
    • Experience with scripting and automation for data preparation, model evaluation harnesses, and offline analysis.
    • Comfortable with relational databases (PostgreSQL), caching layers (Redis), REST, SSE, WebSockets, and event-driven architectures.
    • Production experience with observability, A/B testing, and rolling out model changes safely.
      • Nice to Have
      • Experience with recommendation systems, learning to rank, or search relevance at scale.
      • Marketplace or C2C background covering buyer and seller dynamics, disputes, fraud, and payouts.
      • Multimodal model experience, including vision and image understanding for listings.
      • Arabic NLP or bilingual product experience.
      • Experience with agent frameworks (LangGraph, custom orchestrators) and the judgment to know when to use them.
      • Fine-tuning, LoRA, distillation, or hosting open weight models in production.
      • Open source contributions to LLM tooling, eval frameworks, or retrieval libraries.

What We Care About

    • Ship over the architect. Lean code, no premature abstractions, no half-finished frameworks.

    • Measurement-driven development. Features ship with evals and metrics, not vibes.

    • Ownership. From idea to deployment to monitoring the first real users.

    • Curiosity and range. This role spans many problem domains, and we want someone energized by that.
