jobs.description:
Solenis is a leading global provider of water and hygiene solutions. The company’s product portfolio includes a broad array of water treatment chemistries, process aids, functional additives, cleaners, disinfectants, and state-of-the-art monitoring, control and delivery systems. These technologies are used by customers to improve operational efficiencies, enhance product quality, protect plant assets, minimize environmental impact, and create cleaner and safer environments. Headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware, the company has 78 manufacturing facilities strategically located around the globe and employs a team of over ~23000 professionals in >160 countries across six continents. Solenis is a 2025 Best Managed Company Gold Standard honoree.

For additional information about Solenis, please visitwww.solenis.com or follow us on social media.

Position Summary

Solenis is seeking a driven Key Account Manager to manage and expand a portfolio of pulp mill accounts, serving as a key partner to customers by delivering both process expertise and commercial value. This individual will act as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts, ensuring strong relationship management, reliable program performance, and sustained business growth across the territory.

The role is primarily focused on pulp mill operations and process optimization, with additional value placed on experience supporting broader mill systems such as recovery, power, and water treatment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain and grow existing customer relationships within assigned pulp mill accounts
  • Provide hands-on technical support focused on pulp mill processes, including fiber processing and overall mill performance optimization
  • Review and optimize chemical treatment programs through routine monitoring, performance analysis, and troubleshooting
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to mill personnel by delivering process-focused solutions that improve productivity, quality, and cost efficiency
  • Partner closely with customer teams on-site to support operational performance, process stability, and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Provide support across broader mill systems as needed, including:
    • Recovery and power systems (preferred)
    • Water and utility systems (secondary to pulp-focused responsibilities)
  • Conduct on-site training and technical engagement with plant personnel
  • Develop and execute sales plans to identify and capture new business opportunities within the mill
  • Manage account profitability, including pricing, chemical usage, and receivables
  • Drive safety initiatives and promote best practices at customer sites

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree (technical field preferred; equivalent experience may be considered)
  • Previous experience working in or directly supporting pulp mill operations (required)
  • Strong knowledge of pulp processing and mill operations (required)
  • Experience supporting recovery, power systems, or boiler water chemistry (preferred, not required)
  • Demonstrated ability to provide hands-on technical support in a pulp mill environment
  • Strong relationship management, communication, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to operate independently in a field-based role

Premier Research is looking for a Clinical Research Associate to join our Clinical Monitoring, Site Management and SSU team.

You will help biotech, medtech, and specialty pharma companies transform life-changing ideas and breakthrough science into new medicines, devices, and diagnostics. What we do is profoundly connected to saving and improving lives, and we recognize our team members are the most valuable asset in delivering success.

Join us and build your future here.

  • Delivers quality, timely monitoring reports for sponsor approval per the Clinical Monitoring Plan timelines

  • Maintains submission of expenses according to travel and expense requirements within company guidelines

  • Monitors (remote, onsite, or other approved mode of monitoring) with a focus on data integrity and patient safety in accordance with specific country regulations

  • Plans day to day activities for monitoring of a clinical study and sets priorities per site

  • Undergraduate degree or its international equivalent in clinical, science, or health-related field from an accredited institution; a licensed health-care professional (i.e., registered nurse); or equivalent work experience required

  • Previous clinical research experience required to include at least 1 year of independent monitoring

  • Experience working ideally across all, if not some, of the following therapy areas; Neurology, Oncology, and Dermatology

  • Experience at supporting Phase II & III studies.

The role can be offered as fully remote and applications will ideally be based in central Poland.

Premier Research is dedicated to providing compensation that is fair and competitive with market standards. The minimum annualized starting base pay for this role is 113,000 PLN. jobs.description:
The Opportunity:

Avantor is seeking a Digital Analytics Manager who will be responsible for overseeing the development and enhancement of digital analytics tools and platforms, such as Google Analytics 4, ensuring they meet the business's needs and support data-driven decision-making processes.

The position leads a global team of Digital Analytics Developers.

How you will thrive an create an impact

  • Lead web analytics ecosystem for Avantor, ensuring complete and accurate implementation to provide actionable insights.

  • Build an analytics tag, event, integration, and platform roadmap aligning with business objectives.

  • Lead adoption of Google Analytics 4 globally across all Avantor web properties.

  • Draw upon experience, industry best practices, and knowledge of user behavior to identify tracking opportunities that can drive better customer experiences.

  • Supports major web development projects, code releases, and other IT & Digital Marketing initiatives where custom event tagging and/or dashboards are necessary to monitor success.

  • Gathers information from multiple internal and external sources to create bespoke tagging solutions and advise stakeholders on interpretating results.

  • Develop and maintain documentation, training materials, and support resources to ensure users can effectively utilize digital analytics.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional business and marketing managers to provide digital analytics support for web strategies and initiatives.

  • Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify trends and opportunities in digital analytics, incorporating findings into product strategy and development.

  • Aid in Adobe Target event tagging and Data Layer requirements.

  • Prepare concise reports for executive stakeholders, highlighting key trends and recommendations.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, and business units, to define product requirements and roadmaps for analytics tools and platforms.

  • Work closely with data scientists and analysts to integrate advanced analytics and machine learning models into products, enhancing their capabilities and value.

  • Propose data governance strategies and implement solutions.

  • Other duties as assigned.

What we're looking for

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Computer Science, or related discipline.

  • Minimum 8 years experience in digital marketing or a related field.

  • 5 years of hands-on experience in Product Management experience with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, or other similar digital analytics solutions such as Adobe Analytics.

  • Experience with migration from Universal Analytics to GA4.

  • Google Analytics and Tag Manager certification a plus.

  • Advanced understanding of Google Analytics Tagging is essential.

  • Strong e-marketing channel knowledge.

  • Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

  • Basic SQL experience a plus.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Able to effectively present concepts and reporting data to business users at the Manager / Director / VP level as well as to external customers.

  • Strong Project Management skills.

  • Ability to work with minimal supervision to meet objectives set by Digital Marketing leadership.

  • Ability to effectively foster business relationships across teams and develop a good view of how the business operates.

  • Ability to immerse oneself into product and stories to generate relevant campaigns.

  • Excellent attention to detail and strong organizational skills to manage multiple work requests and projects.

  • Able to independently prioritize workload.

As a NOCD Professional, you will help people with OCD learn how to feel better. Members will enroll with our therapy service via our intake team where they’ll be assigned a practitioner.

Practitioners will assist members through the process of:

  • Therapy: research-backed program that includes live video sessions and app messaging followed by as needed check-ins.

Practitioners will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources. Practitioners will collaborate with our network of psychiatrists and therapists to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions as appropriate.

Our practitioners are supported through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; process groups to support practitioner resilience; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.

  • Knowledge and experience with treating OCD with ERP and/or ACT is preferable but not required
  • Organized, quick and enthusiastic learner, excellent communicator, receptive to feedback, good with time management

NOCD is an award-winning digital health company focused on identifying people with obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) and managing them using evidence-based treatment. Although OCD affects over 181 million people globally, is ranked by the W.H.O. as a top 10 most disabling condition, and costs 3X more to treat than depression, over 90% of the OCD population isn’t able to access effective care due to stigma and misdiagnosis. As a result, OCD patients often go untreated and suffer in silence, which is why it’s nicknamed "the secret illness.”

NOCD is solving this global problem by identifying OCD patients online and managing them using our evidence-based OCD treatment platform. Inside NOCD, members can access a licensed mental health professional with specialty training in OCD who can offer online diagnostic interviews, video-based teletherapy sessions, and message-based support. Position Description

We are seeking a hands on, highly engaged Forward Deployed Engineer (Staff) specializing in Kubernetes, platform modernization, large scale stateful workload migration, and enterprise AI infrastructure. In this role, you will be embedded directly alongside enterprise client teams throughout the entire end to end lifecycle of an engagement. From initial architecture, bare metal/legacy re platforming, and AI cluster setup to live in the field troubleshooting and production rollout.

Because you are part of the core Engineering organization, you won't just file bug reports; you will write production code in the field, build prototype integrations, and channel those contributions directly back to our engineering teams across the Infrastructure Software Division (ISG) to help shape, prioritize, and accelerate high impact platform capabilities. This role sits directly within the Engineering Business Unit (BU), working side by side with product and core software teams. Unlike traditional professional services or post sales support roles, our Forward Deployed Engineering team operates as an extension of core engineering in the field.

Our Core Mission: Reduce customer adoption friction, dramatically shorten software iteration cycles, and establish a high bandwidth, direct feedback loop between real world enterprise deployments and product development.

Key Responsibilities

  • Direct Engineering to Field Collaboration: Act as an embedded engineering liaison across the Infrastructure Software Division, working directly with core software architects, product managers, and enterprise client developers to eliminate deployment friction.
  • Rapid Iteration & Friction Reduction: Identify recurring migration blockers and platform usability gaps in real world customer environments, rapidly building and testing field fixes to shorten feature iteration cycles from months to days.
  • End to End Engagement Ownership: Stay actively embedded with customer technical teams from pre migration discovery through go live and operational stabilization, ensuring successful platform adoption and high customer trust.
  • Hands on Field Implementation & Troubleshooting: Work shoulder to shoulder with client engineers in production environments to write code, build manifests, debug live networking/storage/GPU failures, and optimize VKS performance.
  • Engineering Feedback Loop & Feature Prioritization: Synthesize field tested code, architectural patterns, and customer pain points directly into core engineering requirements. Partner with product managers and core engineers to translate customer contributions into prioritized platform features.
  • VKS & AI Infrastructure Architecture: Architect, deploy, and maintain production grade vSphere Kubernetes Service (VKS) clusters across VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) and hybrid cloud infrastructure, optimized for both general purpose compute and accelerated GPU/NPU workloads.
  • Bare Metal & Legacy Platform Migration: Lead technical migration strategies transitioning enterprise platforms, massive bare metal environments, and legacy data stacks over to VKS or cloud native Kubernetes targets.
  • Enterprise AI & Inferencing Modernization: Deploy, tune, and scale production AI inferencing workloads, RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures, vector search, and model serving frameworks on Kubernetes using virtualized GPU resources (NVIDIA vGPU, MIG).
  • Data Services & Messaging Re Platforming: Containerize, refactor, and migrate heavy stateful engines, message brokers (Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ), distributed caches (Redis, Oracle Coherence, Hazelcast), and risk calculation/analytics platforms onto Kubernetes.
  • Modern Data & AI Stack Modernization: Architect operator driven, cloud native deployments for data processing, orchestration, and distributed AI frameworks (Ray, vLLM, Apache Spark, Apache Airflow, Trino/Presto, Flink, Dask, Cassandra/ScyllaDB, Milvus/Qdrant).
  • Multi Kubernetes Integration: Guide clients evaluating or operating VKS alongside competing distributions (Red Hat OpenShift, Amazon EKS, Google GKE, Azure AKS, Rancher RKE/RKS).

Key Qualifications

  • Engineering Mindset & Organizational Fit: Deep alignment with product engineering workflows; experience functioning within or closely alongside core software/R&D divisions rather than pure IT or professional services.
  • Full Lifecycle Engagement Experience: Proven track record of staying deeply engaged with customer technical leadership and developers across long term, complex engineering projects.
  • Product Minded Engineering: Demonstrated ability to translate raw technical customer requirements and field workarounds into clean product specifications and feature requests for core development teams.
  • AI & Accelerated Compute Infrastructure: Hands on experience operating GPU accelerated Kubernetes nodes, model serving runtimes (vLLM, TGI, Triton Inference Server), vector databases (Milvus, Qdrant, Pgvector), and distributed AI orchestration (Ray, KubeRay).
  • Distributed Systems & Stateful Workloads: Hands on experience containerizing and operating high throughput/low latency platforms:Distributed Caching & In Memory Grids: Redis, Oracle Coherence, Hazelcast
  • Compute & Analytics Engines: Risk calculation platforms, Hadoop (HDFS/YARN)
  • Messaging & Streaming: Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, Pulsar
  • Cloud Native Data & AI Stack Depth: Deep technical knowledge of deploying, tuning, and scaling containerized data services, AI engines, and orchestrators:
  • Batch, Real Time & AI Processing: Ray, vLLM, Apache Spark, Apache Flink, Dask
  • Orchestration & Workflow: Apache Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, Argo Workflows
  • Query, NoSQL & Vector Engines: Trino/Presto, Apache Cassandra / ScyllaDB, Elasticsearch / OpenSearch, Milvus, Qdrant
  • Multi Kubernetes Proficiency: Technical depth across competing enterprise distributions (OpenShift, EKS, GKE, AKS, or Rancher RKE/RKS).
  • Infrastructure as Code & GitOps: Advanced skills in Terraform, Helm, Kubernetes Operators (KPO), Cluster API (CAPI), and GitOps (ArgoCD, Flux).

Bachelor's degree preferred. Relevant year's experience in lieu of a degree may be considered.

12+ years related experience required

Job Description


Job Title: Client Delivery Executive

Locations: Florida - Remote

About the Role

The Client Delivery Executive (CDE) is a senior client relationship leader responsible for building and expanding strategic partnerships with some of SS&C Health’s most important healthcare clients. Serving as a trusted advisor and executive point of contact, the CDE develops a deep understanding of each client’s business, strategic priorities, operating environment, and evolving needs.

Working across health plans, pharmacy benefit organizations, and other healthcare organizations, the CDE connects client priorities with SS&C Health’s capabilities across technology, pharmacy, operations, data, and services. This role brings together the right leaders and resources across SS&C to ensure we deliver on our commitments, proactively address challenges, and continually identify opportunities to create greater value for the client.

The CDE is ultimately accountable for the health and strength of the overall client relationship, including executive engagement, client satisfaction, retention, strategic alignment, and growth.

Why Join SS&C

SS&C combines proprietary technology with deep industry expertise to support complex financial and health care operations. Our teams design, implement, and operate solutions that help clients manage data, automate processes, and scale their businesses with confidence.

You will work with industry experts, modern platforms, and evolving technologies, gaining exposure to real-world operational challenges and large-scale enterprise environments.

How You Will Make an Impact

  • Serve as the senior relationship leader and primary executive point of contact for assigned strategic healthcare clients.

  • Develop trusted relationships with senior executives and key stakeholders across health plans, PBMs, pharmacy organizations, and other healthcare organizations.

  • Build a deep understanding of each client’s business strategy, market dynamics, operating model, technology environment, regulatory priorities, and long-term objectives.

  • Establish and maintain a comprehensive client strategy and account plan that identifies priorities, relationship opportunities, risks, growth opportunities, and executive engagement needs.

  • Serve as the voice of the client within SS&C Health, ensuring client priorities and concerns are understood and addressed across Product, Technology, Operations, Implementation, Sales, Finance, and other teams.

  • Provide executive oversight of the overall client experience and ensure SS&C consistently delivers against contractual commitments, strategic priorities, and client expectations.

  • Proactively identify relationship, operational, delivery, and commercial risks and mobilize the appropriate internal leaders before issues materially impact the client.

  • Lead executive governance, business reviews, strategic planning sessions, and other senior-level client interactions.

  • Coordinate executive sponsorship and ensure appropriate SS&C leadership engagement across the client relationship.

  • Partner with Product and Technology leaders to connect client priorities with SS&C Health’s product strategy, roadmap, and investment areas.

  • Maintain strong knowledge of the healthcare market, including payer operations, pharmacy and PBM dynamics, healthcare technology, regulatory trends, and emerging client needs.

  • Identify opportunities to expand the relationship by connecting client business challenges with additional SS&C Health capabilities and solutions.

  • Partner closely with Sales on account growth while maintaining primary focus on the long-term health, value, and strategic strength of the client relationship.

  • Maintain a clear view of overall client health, including satisfaction, executive relationships, delivery performance, financial performance, risks, renewal outlook, and growth potential.

  • Act as an executive escalation point when significant issues arise, ensuring clear communication, accountability, and timely resolution.

  • Drive strong client retention and establish SS&C Health as a strategic partner rather than simply a technology or services vendor.

Required Experience

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in healthcare, with significant experience managing complex, enterprise-level client relationships.

  • Strong understanding of the health payer and/or pharmacy ecosystem, including health plans, PBMs, pharmacy operations, healthcare technology, claims administration, or related services.

  • Strong executive presence with the ability to navigate difficult conversations, influence decisions, resolve conflict, and build alignment across organizations.

  • Ability to operate effectively in a matrixed organization and mobilize cross-functional teams without relying on direct authority.

  • Strong judgment and ability to recognize emerging client risks, determine when executive intervention is needed, and drive issues to resolution.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-management skills.

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree or equivalent healthcare industry experience preferred.

How Success Will Be Measured

Success in this role will be measured by the strength and depth of executive client relationships, client satisfaction and retention, proactive management of client risks, delivery against commitments, successful renewals, expansion of strategic relationships, and the degree to which clients view SS&C Health as a trusted and valued strategic partner.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Purpose

The primary focus of this role is to assess and improve data quality across the organization by developing data standards, governance processes, and monitoring controls for critical data assets. The role partners with cross-functional stakeholders to gather business metadata requirements, define data quality metrics, and drive data governance initiatives that support accurate, reliable, and trusted data.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain data quality KPIs, scorecards, dashboards, and governance maturity assessments.
  • Design and implement data quality solutions, including data profiling, business rule development, root cause analysis, monitoring controls, and exception management processes.
  • Analyze data health and provide recommendations for data standards, controls, and governance practices to improve the quality and integrity of critical data assets.
  • Identify data quality risks and proactively recommend preventive and corrective actions.
  • Partner with Data Owners, Data Stewards, Category Managers, business stakeholders, and technical teams to identify, investigate, and resolve data quality issues.
  • Gather, document, and maintain business metadata, business glossaries, data definitions, and data quality requirements.
  • Manage and enhance metadata repositories and data catalog content within Alation, ensuring metadata remains accurate, complete, and current.
  • Develop and maintain data governance artifacts, including policies, standards, procedures, and governance documentation.
  • Identify, classify, and govern critical, sensitive, and consent-related data elements across the organization.
  • Document and maintain data lineage, data flows, business processes, and Critical Data Elements (CDEs).
  • Utilize SQL, Python, Tableau, Cognos, Excel, and other analytical tools to extract, analyze, monitor, and report on data quality trends.
  • Develop and automate reporting and monitoring solutions to support data governance and business objectives.
  • Promote data governance best practices, data ownership, metadata management, and data literacy through stakeholder engagement, training, and communication.
  • Provide data governance and data quality expertise throughout project planning, design, and implementation activities.

Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes, evaluate impacts, and implement effective solutions.
  • Solid understanding of data governance, data quality management, metadata management, and process improvement methodologies.
  • Ability to analyze complex datasets and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Experience managing multiple priorities while delivering high-quality results within established timelines.
  • Strong organizational, planning, and project coordination skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to effectively engage both business and technical stakeholders.

Education

Experience

Objectif

L’objectif principal de ce rôle est d’évaluer et d’améliorer la qualité des données à l’échelle de l’organisation en élaborant des normes de données, des processus de gouvernance et des contrôles de surveillance pour les actifs de données critiques. La personne titulaire du poste collabore avec des parties prenantes interfonctionnelles afin de recueillir les exigences en matière de métadonnées d’affaires, de définir les indicateurs de qualité des données et de faire progresser les initiatives de gouvernance des données qui favorisent des données exactes, fiables et dignes de confiance.

Responsabilités

  • Élaborer et maintenir des indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) liés à la qualité des données, des tableaux de bord de suivi, des cartes de pointage et des évaluations de la maturité en matière de gouvernance.

  • Grand souci du détail, avec un niveau élevé de précision et une attention particulière portée à la qualité.

Product Department

The Product team at Vantage defines and stewards our global product platform: the customer outcomes we aim to deliver, the standards and reference approaches that make delivery repeatable, and the closed-loop learning that turns each deployment into an upgrade for the next. We do this in partnership with Engineering, Delivery, Operations, Procurement, Sustainability, Sales, Site Selection, and Business Development, aligning priorities and trade-offs while preserving clear functional ownership for design execution, construction delivery, and site operations.

Position Summary

Vantage is building the next generation of digital infrastructure through industrialized product platforms, standardized deployment systems, and long-range technology strategy. As demand for AI, advanced computing, and digital infrastructure continues to accelerate, energy hasemergedas the defining constraint to growth. The ability toacquire, integrate,optimize, and scale energy infrastructure has become a strategic differentiator.

The Senior Director, Energy Systemsis responsible fordefining and stewarding Vantage’s global energy systems strategy and product roadmap.

This role owns the vision, strategy, and development of the energy layer of the Vantage product platform, translating evolving utility markets, interconnection and regulatory changes, customer requirements, power infrastructure constraints, grid modernization trends, and validated technology innovations into scalable energy products and deployment models.

The position serves as the primary product steward for Vantage’s energy systems portfolio, including behind-, front-, across-the-meter energy solutions, power generation integration, energy storage, grid-interactive infrastructure, energy optimization systems, and future energy platform capabilities.

Success in this role requires a demonstrated blend of commercial, technical, and strategicexpertise. The ideal candidate possesses deep knowledge of energy markets, energy contracting and partnerships, utility interconnection processes, many power generation technologies, transmission and distribution systems, and energy infrastructure development, while also understanding how to convert those capabilities into repeatable product offerings that create long-term competitive advantage. First-hand experience is preferred, especially across multiple regions (e.g., utilities / balancing authorities, ISOs / RTOs), types of energy partners (e.g., OEMs, EPCs, IPPs), and partnership methods (e.g., JV, equity, co-development).

Working closely with teams across the Energy and Productorganizationsthis individual will ensure energy innovations evolve into scalable platform capabilities that can be consistently deployed across Vantage’s global footprint.

Role Purpose

The Senior Director, Energy Systems is accountable for defining the multi-year strategy, roadmap, and product portfolio governing the energy layer of the Vantage platform.

The roleestablisheshow energy infrastructure, generation resources, storage systems, utility relationships, grid integration strategies, and emerging energy solutions contribute to customer value, capacity growth, resilience, speed-to-market, and long-term business performance.

The Senior Director, Energy Systems owns the integration of those validated technologies into the product roadmap, platform architecture, deployment strategies, and regional enablement models.

The role also serves as a bridge between innovation and scale — ensuring that evolving energy capabilities move beyond successful pilots and become durable, repeatable, globally deployable product offerings while also communicating energy needs back to inform the next generation of innovation.

Key Responsibilities

Global Energy Strategy

  • Develop multi-year roadmaps for energy infrastructure, power acquisition strategies, generation integration, storage deployment, and grid-connected energy solutions.

  • Translate customer requirements, market intelligence, supply chain constraints, utility dynamics, interconnection evolution, regulatory changes, and policy developments into product direction and investment priorities.

  • Evaluate future energy trends anddeterminewhere Vantage should build, buy, partner, or influence.

Energy Systems Product Portfolio

  • Own the product strategy and portfolio for energy-related platform capabilities.

  • Define repeatable energy system architectures, deployment models, standards, and intentional variants.

  • Create scalable approaches for: power generation integration, energy storage systems, grid-interactive infrastructure, load flexibility and energy optimization, utility coordination frameworks, and energy management and control systems.

  • Ensure energy capabilities are developed as reusable platform components rather than project-specific solutions.

Utility, Interconnection & Power Market Leadership

  • Provide strategic leadership on utility engagement and grid infrastructure considerations.

  • Proactively translate evolving grid requirements into the energy platform.

  • Develop frameworks and guidance relatedto:utility partnerships, grid interconnection strategy, capacity acquisition approaches, transmission and distribution considerations, and power market participation opportunities.

  • Support strategic customer opportunities requiring sophisticated energy solutions.

  • Evaluate regional power market dynamics and their implications for platform strategy.

Road mapping & Technology Integration

  • Partner closely with the Senior Director, Advanced Technologies to incorporate validated innovations into the Vantage product roadmap and provide evolving energy needs to inform the next generation of innovation.

  • Translate technology pilot outcomes and validation results into product requirements, deployment standards, and investment priorities.

  • Collaborate with Product Engineering to ensure roadmap decisions are reflected through reference architectures and design standards.

  • Ensure technology adoption decisions align with long-term platform goals, deployment realities, and business outcomes.

  • Serve as the primary product leader responsible for connecting innovation activity with scalable product development.

Regional Partnership & Deployment Enablement

  • Establish a product deployment framework for energy systems aligned to Vantage’s product operating model.

jobs.description:
About Cardlytics
Founded in 2008, Cardlytics (NASDAQ: CDLX) is the industry-leading purchase intelligence and incentives platform. We make commerce smarter and more rewarding for everyone by helping businesses attract, understand, and incentivize consumers through our partners' digital reward programs. Join us on our mission to make commerce smarter and more rewarding for everyone!

About the Position

Cardlytics is seeking a highly organized, candidate-centered Talent Acquisition Specialist to support our lean, high-impact Talent Acquisition function. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys balancing recruiting operations with talent sourcing and candidate engagement.

You will serve as a key partner to the Head of Talent Acquisition, helping deliver a thoughtful, efficient hiring experience for candidates, hiring managers, and interviewers. You will manage the details that keep hiring moving - from interview coordination and candidate communication to sourcing, screening, offer administration, and ATS workflow management.

This role is ideal for a recruiting professional who is comfortable operating independently, can manage competing priorities with sound judgment, and is eager to grow into broader full-cycle recruiting ownership.

You will

  • Coordinate complex interviews, calendars, and interviewer panels; manage reschedules and ensure a seamless candidate experience.

  • Own candidate communications throughout the process, including interview confirmations, preparation, follow-up, and status updates.

  • Partner with the Head of TA to source and build diverse pipelines for priority roles using LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, referrals, talent mapping, and other outbound strategies.

  • Review resumes and conduct structured initial screens for defined roles, evaluating core qualifications, motivation, and alignment with role requirements.

  • Maintain accurate, timely data and workflows, including candidate stages, interview feedback, requisition activity, and reporting.

  • Coordinate offer-process administration, including drafting offer letters and employment documentation, initiating background checks, and managing candidate pre-hire workflows.

  • Monitor interview feedback and follow up with interviewers and hiring teams to keep processes moving and decisions timely.

  • Partner with the Head of TA and hiring teams to deliver a consistent, professional, and equitable interview process.

  • Identify friction points in the hiring experience and recommend practical improvements to workflows, templates, systems, and communication.

  • Support additional recruiting and people-team initiatives as business needs evolve.

  • Support full-cycle recruiting for assigned, lower-complexity searches as experience and readiness develop.

You have

  • 5+ years of experience in recruiting, recruiting operations, talent sourcing, or recruiting support in an in-house or agency environment.

  • Demonstrated success managing complex interview scheduling, multi-stakeholder communications, and confidential candidate information.

  • Strong sourcing fundamentals, including LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, candidate research, and outreach.

  • Experience conducting candidate phone screens or a clear ability to learn structured screening quickly.

  • A candidate-first mindset and high bar for service, responsiveness, and professionalism.

The anticipated annual base salary range for this role is $100–$125 USD. Actual compensation will vary based on location, experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

Technical Environment

We primarily use macOS and Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides). While our preferred platform is macOS, we support both macOS and Windows. Familiarity with or willingness to work within this environment is required.

Core Values

Our shared values are the driving force behind everything we do. Across all roles, we are looking for teammates who embody these values:

  • Customer and partner first

  • Integrity with our partners and data

  • Accountability even when challenged

jobs.title: Sr Public Relations Manager
jobs.excerpt: Who we are.  Network Solutions, a global leader helping small businesses succeed online with websites, domains, hosting and more, is looking for a creative, hands-on Senior PR Manager to turn our multi-channel content engine into meaningful earned media coverage, and to make sure that coverage lives well beyond the press hit.
jobs.description:
Who we are.

Network Solutions, a global leader helping small businesses succeed online with websites, domains, hosting and more, is looking for a creative, hands-on Senior PR Manager to turn our multi-channel content engine into meaningful earned media coverage, and to make sure that coverage lives well beyond the press hit.

This is a role for a proactive PR professional, someone who has independently run PR programs end-to-end, knows how to spot a story before others see it, and has the media relationships and instinct to turn insights into headlines. You’ll also be the connective tissue between PR and social storytelling, making sure our biggest data studies, press wins, and executive moments get a second life on social.

Your work begins with curiosity. You will dig into blogs, survey data, customer stories, product roadmaps, SEO insights, and conversations with in-house experts to uncover story ideas worth sharing. Then, as a story strategist, you will transform those insights into narratives that align with our brand priorities and resonate with the media. You will collaborate closely with the Content, Customer Insights, SEO, Video and Social teams to shape data-driven narratives and craft story angles that extend across channels, powered by strong editorial instincts and the best of AI. Finally, you will partner with our PR firm to collaboratively and individually pitch those stories to top-tier, trade, tech, and SMB outlets, and partner with Social to carry them forward.

You will play a key role in connecting PR strategy to our broader storytelling across blog, social, video, and executive visibility. This is not a reactive press release role; it is a strategic, high-impact seat at the content table. You won’t just mine stories, pitch drafts or write press releases, you will connect teams, elevate ideas, and help shape how the world sees a global brand in motion.

What you’ll do & how you’ll make your mark.

  • Spot the story before it’s assigned. Monitor content calendars, product roadmaps, survey insights, and customer trends to proactively surface timely media angles and earned coverage opportunities.

  • Shape and execute strategic media campaigns. Drive a steady flow of high-impact, customized pitches supported by press releases, quotes, bylines, and reporter prep materials, all crafted by you to align with brand messaging and business goals.

  • Lead data-driven storytelling, start to finish. Partner closely with our Content lead and our data-journalism research partner to shape study topics from the headline down, review research drafts for newsworthiness, and work with our PR agency partner on pitching — ensuring every study is built for amplification across PR, blog, social and video.

  • Be the bridge between PR and Social. Serve as the direct link to the Social team, making sure published research, data studies, and press wins are translated into engaging, platform-native social content — and champion executive leaders in authoring long-form LinkedIn articles tied to key studies and results.

  • Amplify executive thought leadership. Identify and secure opportunities for leaders to contribute commentary, interviews, podcasts, bylines, and timely expert perspectives (often helping to draft these) in top-tier media and on their own social channels.

  • Cultivate strong press relationships. Deepen visibility across tech, SMB, trade, and data-driven business press through consistent, tailored outreach via email, social and calls.

  • Use AI tools to work smarter. Leverage AI to brainstorm, outline, personalize and accelerate story development, while contributing to our evolving approach to AI-enabled communications.

  • Track what matters. Monitor earned media coverage, share of voice, sentiment, and survey impact to continually refine pitch strategy and messaging.

Who you are & what you’ll need to succeed.

You’re a PR pro with a journalist’s instinct for storytelling and a marketer’s eye for relevance. You don’t wait to be assigned work; you listen, observe, and connect the dots. You bring sharp editorial judgment and recognize newsworthiness instinctively. When you hear something promising in a meeting, roadmap review, or insights discussion, you immediately see the angleand you know it doesn’t stop at the press hit; you see how it plays on social, too.

You view earned media as a strategic lever, not an output, and know how to extract compelling narratives from raw inputs. You excel at turning insights into headlines, building lasting media relationships, asking smart questions, and translating complex topics into storylines across channels, including social.

Whether your background is agency, in-house or a mix of both, you thrive in fast-moving, content-rich environments. You’re curious, adaptable, and energized by how AI and new tools can elevate storytelling.

  • You’ve built strong relationships with key journalists and consistently secure meaningful coverage that advances our brand narrative.

  • Insights (i.e., data, trends, customer stories) regularly become compelling, timely, multi-channel narratives that show up across PR, blog, social and video.

  • Data studies and press wins consistently get a second life on social and executive leaders are publishing long-form LinkedIn articles tied to key research and results.

  • You’re viewed as an initiative-taking, strategic partner who brings earned media thinking into product conversations, content planning, and brand storytelling.

  • You’veestablished a predictable PR rhythm through a thoughtful media calendar, consistent outreach, and a steady flow of timely ideas.

  • You’ve helped sharpen how the brand shows up externally, contributing to a cohesive, insight-driven story in the market across earned media and social alike.

Requirements

  • 6-10+ years in PR, with B2B tech/SaaS experience

  • Existing relationships with top-tier and tech journalists

  • Strong news sense and ability to translate insights into stories

  • Direct pitching experience and comfort driving outbound media

  • Exceptional writing skills across formats: press releases, tailored pitches, bylines, spokesperson quotes, talking points

  • Fluency in social storytelling — able to spot how a press hit, data study, or executive moment should show up on social (especially LinkedIn) and comfortable partnering closely with a Social team to bring it to life

  • Skilled at managing cross-functional relationships

  • Comfortable using AI tools to accelerate research and content development

  • Experience managing or partnering with PR agencies

Nice-to-Haves

  • Based in the Eastern time zone

  • Mixed background (agency + in-house)

  • Experience with data storytelling or insights-driven narratives, ideally including survey- or research-based campaigns

  • Experience partnering with a data-journalism or research agency on earned media campaigns

  • Familiarity with domains, hosting, website builders, or digital presence platforms

  • Experience in PR during a rebrand or brand transformation

Travel

Limited travel (approx. 1–3 trips per year for planning meetings, events, or media engagements)

Why you’ll love us.

  • We are in a major rebrand, and you’ll help shape how the world sees a legacy brand on the rise across press and social and LLMs.

  • Huge storytelling runway: millions of customers, a data-rich environment, and content engines across blog, survey, SEO, video, social and product.

  • A chance to influence visibility of a global brand across multiple channels.

  • A positive, high-growth environment where autonomy is paired with close leadership access and collaboration.

  • A cross-functional ecosystem that’s collaborative, energetic and committed to elevating our stories.

  • Opportunities to experiment with AI, data, and next-generation PR methodologies.

  • We’ve evolved; we provide three work environment scenarios. You can feel like a Newfolder in a work-from-home, hybrid, or work-from-the-office environment.

  • Work-life balance. Our work is thrilling and meaningful, but we know balance is key to living well.

  • We celebrate one another’s differences. We’re proud of our culture of diversity and inclusion. We foster a culture of belonging. Our company and customers benefit when employees bring their authentic selves to work. We have programs that bring us together on important issues and provide learning and development opportunities for all employees. We have 20 + affinity groups where you can network and connect with Newfolders globally.

  • We care about you. We provide excellent Health Insurance options to fit you, HSA, Medical, Dental, Vision, Matching 401K, Life/AD&D/STD/LTD, Tuition Reimbursement, Pet Insurance, Generous vacation policy, and much more!

  • Where can we take you? We’re fans of helping our employees learn different aspects of the business, be challenged with new tasks, be mentored, and grow their careers. Unfold new possibilities with #teamnewfold!

#NetworkSolutions

Employment with Newfold Digital is at-will and nothing in this Job Description should be interpreted or construed to alter the at-will employment relationship.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation abilities.
  • Ability to translate scientific knowledge into business opportunities.
  • Strong collaboration and cross-functional leadership skills.
  • Customer-focused with a results-driven mindset.

The Internal Controls Associate is responsible for supporting and enhancing the organization's overall internal control environment across business operations, technology platforms, financial reporting, information security, regulatory compliance, and risk management activities. This role evaluates the design and effectiveness of controls, documents key processes and procedures, maintains evidence to demonstrate control performance, and collaborates with business and technology teams to identify, assess, and mitigate risks.

The Internal Controls Associate assists with internal audits, operational reviews, control testing and/or execution, remediation efforts, and compliance initiatives related to applicable laws, regulations, industry standards, and contractual obligations. Responsibilities extend beyond any single regulatory framework and may include supporting compliance with Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX), privacy regulations, cybersecurity requirements, insurance industry regulations, and other governance, risk, and compliance obligations as applicable to the organization.

This position plays a key role in promoting a strong control culture by continuously assessing organizational risks, identifying control gaps, recommending improvements, and helping ensure that the company's overall control environment remains effective, sustainable, and aligned with business objectives, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.

Key Responsibilities

Internal Control Program Administration

  • Assist in the design, implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the organization's internal control framework.
  • Document and maintain policies, procedures, process flows, risk and control matrices (RCMs), and control narratives in alignment with COSO principles.
  • Ensure controls are appropriately designed to mitigate identified business, operational, financial, compliance, and technology risks.

Risk Assessment and Control Design

  • Perform periodic risk assessments across business and technology functions.
  • Identify control gaps, emerging risks, and process inefficiencies.
  • Develop and recommend risk mitigation strategies and control enhancements.
  • Support enterprise risk management and compliance initiatives.

Control Testing and Monitoring

  • Develop and execute control testing procedures to evaluate control design and operating effectiveness.
  • Analyze testing results, identify deficiencies, and track remediation activities.
  • Maintain evidence supporting control execution and effectiveness.
  • Monitor key controls through continuous auditing and data analytics techniques where applicable.

Regulatory and Compliance Support

  • Support compliance with applicable regulations, standards, and contractual obligations, including:
    • Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX)
    • State insurance regulations
    • Privacy regulations (CCPA, CPRA, GDPR, etc.)
    • Cybersecurity and information security requirements
    • SOC reporting, PCI DSS, and other industry-specific frameworks as applicable
  • Assist in preparing regulatory examinations, audits, and compliance assessments.

Audit Coordination and Management

  • Serve as a primary liaison for Internal Audit and external auditors.
  • Coordinate audit requests and facilitate walkthroughs, interviews, and evidence collection.
  • Respond to audit inquiries and support remediation efforts.
  • Track audit findings and ensure corrective actions are implemented timely.

Operational and Business Process Reviews

  • Evaluate operational processes to identify risks, inefficiencies, and control weaknesses.
  • Conduct special reviews and investigations relating to control failures, incidents, or identified concerns.
  • Participate in assessments related to fraud prevention, business continuity, vendor management, and cybersecurity.

Reporting and Stakeholder Engagement

  • Prepare clear, concise, and audit-ready reports summarizing risks, control effectiveness, and recommendations.
  • Communicate findings and corrective action plans to business and technology leadership.
  • Escalate significant issues and emerging risks appropriately.
  • Present control-related information to management committees and stakeholders.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to enhance operational efficiency, governance, and compliance processes.
  • Assist in developing metrics, dashboards, and reporting to monitor control effectiveness.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, risk awareness, and strong internal controls throughout the organization.
  • Stay informed on regulatory changes, emerging risks, and industry best practices affecting the insurance sector.

Other Duties

  • Support control, audit, risk management, governance, compliance, and operational initiatives as assigned by Internal Controls leadership.
  • Perform additional control-related activities necessary to maintain an effective enterprise-wide control environment.

Core Competencies that predict success in a high-accountability Internal Controls Role:

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance or Tech preferred
  • 1-2 years of experience in internal controls, external or internal audit positions.
  • Big four or banking experience is a plus.

jobs.description:
Position title: Battery Simulation Engineer
Employment type: Full-time

Job description:

As a Battery Simulation Engineer, you will be responsible for developing, validating, and applying electrical and thermal models of battery cells, modules, and full packs. Your work will directly support the development and integration of high-performance, safe, and reliable battery systems across various applications. This role requires a strong foundation in battery fundamentals, simulation techniques, high-voltage electrical circuits, and systems-level thinking. You will respond to technical requests using established tools and methodologies while also contributing to the development of new modeling approaches to address emerging challenges in battery safety and performance.

The responsibilities in this position include, but are not limited to:
- Develop and implement physics-based and empirical models for simulating the electrical, thermal, and degradation performance of lithium-ion battery systems.

  • Conduct 1D simulation studies to evaluate battery behavior under various electrical, thermal, and environmental conditions, including fast charging, thermal events, and aging.
  • Analyze laboratory test data to extract model parameters, validate simulation results, and improve model robustness.
  • Perform sensitivity studies, scenario simulation, and model-based evaluations to support design and engineering decisions.
  • Collaborate closely with cell, module, and pack design engineers, as well as test and control teams, to define requirements and optimize system performance.
  • Prepare technical documentation, reports, and presentations summarizing modeling methodology and simulation outcomes.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product teams and share progress and insights with stakeholders.

Basic qualifications:

  • Master of Science degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Aerospace/Aeronautical Engineering, or Applied Physics from an ABET-accredited university.
    - Minimum of 2 years of experience using simulation tools for engineering applications.
    - Hands-on experience with 0D/1D battery simulation and analysis tools such as GT-SUITE, MATLAB/Simulink, Amesim, or equivalent.
    - Strong Understanding of lithium-ion battery fundamentals, including battery performance characteristics, thermal characteristics, and aging mechanisms.
  • Fundamental understanding of HV electrical circuits, busbar design, and Battery Disconnect Unit (BDU) functionality within a battery system.
  • Ability to analyze data, interpret results, and communicate findings clearly.
  • Experience with optimization methods (DOE, parameter estimation, control optimization).
    - Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to clearly present technical findings to cross-functional teams.
    - Proven teamwork, interpersonal skills, and the ability to solve complex technical problems using analytical and simulation-based approaches.

Preferred qualifications:
- Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or Electrical Engineering with a focus on battery systems, electrochemistry, or thermal management.
- Hands-on experience with battery testing methods, aging studies, and performance evaluation.
- Proficiency in developing and applying 0D/1D/3D simulation models for battery systems.
- Background in embedded controls, Kalman filters, or estimator design for SOC/SOH/SOP.
- Good overall knowledge of battery performance and thermal management.
- Good skills in programming with commercial software (e.g., MATLAB/Simulink, Python, Visual C++).

jobs.description:
Career-defining. Life-changing.

At iRhythm, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills and your career while impacting the lives of people around the world. iRhythm is shaping a future where everyone, everywhere can access the best possible cardiac health solutions. Every day, we collaborate, create, and constantly reimagine what’s possible. We think big and move fast, driven by our commitment to put patients first and improve lives. We need builders like you. Curious and innovative problem solvers looking for the chance to meaningfully shape the future of cardiac health, our company, and your career

About This Role:

The Real World Evidence Manager is a highly technical, hands-on research role that serves as an analytical engine for iRhythm’s RWE and health economics program. Reporting to the Senior Ditector, Global Value and Access Innovation, this individual manages the execution and quality of quantitative analyses that generate the clinical, economic, and real-world evidence underpinning the Zio platform’s value proposition to US payers and health systems.

This role combines independent analytical execution with strong methodological rigor, carrying analytical workstreams from protocol through peer-reviewed dissemination. The RWE Manager serves as the primary programmer and model builder, producing analytical outputs that directly influence payer coverage decisions, health system contracting, and product strategy with secondary support for international (OUS) value and access workstreams.

Key Responsibilities

Real-World Evidence (RWE) Design & Execution

▪ Manage the execution of retrospective and prospective RWE studies using claims data (Medicare, Medicaid, commercial), EMR/EHR data, and proprietary iRhythm clinical datasets.

▪ Operationalize study protocols, analytic plans, variable definitions, and statistical methodologies appropriate for payer and peer-reviewed audiences.

▪ Apply advanced epidemiological methods including propensity score matching, instrumental variables, difference-in-differences, interrupted time series, and survival analysis.

▪ Ensure reproducibility, auditability, and documentation of all analytical pipelines.

Health Economic Modeling

▪ Build and maintain sophisticated health economic models including budget impact models (BIMs), cost-effectiveness models, and payer decision-support tools.

▪ Translate clinical evidence into economic inputs with appropriate uncertainty characterization.

▪ Develop and update payer-facing economic tools that field and account teams can deploy in customer engagements.

▪ Conduct sensitivity analyses, scenario modeling, and probabilistic analyses (PSA) consistent with HTA standards.

Statistical Programming & Data Infrastructure

▪ Serve as the primary statistical programmer for RWE and health economic projects, with proficiency in R, Python, SAS, or equivalent tools.

▪ Design and maintain analytical data infrastructure including datasets, codebooks, data dictionaries, and QC processes.

▪ Work with data vendors, CROs, and internal data science teams to access, clean, and validate data assets.

▪ Implement and maintain version-controlled analytical repositories (GitHub or equivalent).

Scientific Communication & Publication

▪ Prepare scientific abstracts, posters, and manuscripts for ISPOR, AMCP, ACC/AHA, HRS, and peer-reviewed journals.

▪ Translate complex analytical findings into clear, audience-appropriate formats for payer, clinical, and executive audiences.

▪ Co-author or contribute to health economic dossiers, coverage submissions, and payer value tools.

Cross-Functional Leadership

▪ Partner with Medical Affairs, Clinical Research, Commercial, and Payer Relations teams to align evidence generation with strategic priorities.

▪ Represent analytical workstreams in stakeholder engagements, as designated by the Director.

▪ Mentor interns and junior analysts on research methodology, data analysis, and scientific writing.

Qualifications

Required

▪ Masters or doctoral degree (MS, MPH, PhD) in Health Economics, Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Public Health, or a highly quantitative related field.

▪ 3+ years of progressive experience in HEOR, RWE, or health economic analytics within the pharmaceutical, biotech, diagnostics, or digital health industry (or equivalent academic/consulting background).

▪ Expert-level proficiency in at least two of: R, Python, SAS, STATA for statistical analysis and data management.

▪ Demonstrated experience designing and executing observational studies using claims or EMR data.

▪ Strong track record of health economic model development (BIM, CEA, cost-utility models).

▪ Peer-reviewed publication record or equivalent demonstrated scientific output (abstracts, posters, dossier contributions).

▪ Strong analytical judgment and ability to execute rigorous analyses and communicate methodological choices clearly.

Preferred

▪ PhD in Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Health Economics, or related field.

▪ Prior experience in cardiac electrophysiology, digital diagnostics, or ambulatory monitoring.

▪ Familiarity with US reimbursement structures (CMS, Medicare Advantage, commercial payers) and their evidentiary requirements.

▪ Experience with NCQA/HEDIS measure development or quality measurement frameworks.

▪ Proficiency with data platforms such as Optum Clinformatics, IBM MarketScan, TriNetX, or Komodo Health.

▪ Tableau or equivalent visualization platform experience.

Core Competencies

▪ Methodological Rigor: Applies advanced research methods with scientific independence and defensibility.

▪ Analytical Leadership: Drives analytical workstreams end-to-end with minimal supervision.

▪ Strategic Communication: Translates complex data into compelling, actionable insights.

▪ Cross-Functional Partnership: Works effectively with commercial, clinical, and policy stakeholders.

▪ Scientific Integrity: Upholds highest standards of research quality, reproducibility, and

jobs.excerpt: At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen.
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Sales Manager

__

At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

Vendor Enablement is a critical operational function responsible for ensuring ABB Inc. is accurately represented, established, compliant and fully functional as a supplier within customer-managed platforms and procurement systems. As a key contact for Front End Sales and Clients, the function supports onboarding through vendor registration forms, complex surveys, and portal administration; engaging internally and externally to establish and maintain the digital trade relationship.

Vendor Enablement Specialists serve as a central point of coordination and support across Sales, Accounting, Compliance, HSE, Risk Management, and Contract teams, ensuring alignment between internal operations and external (client) system requirements. As a member of this team you will operate within Case Management, navigate multiple platforms, manage shared inboxes, and support special administrative projects: requiring strong prioritization, cross-functional awareness, and timely resolution of requests. Through this work the role directly supports revenue continuity by enabling timely registration, transaction processing, accurate purchase order routing, maintaining system visibility and user management.

Your Responsibilities

  • Case Management & Workflow Ownership: Owns end-to-end case management, coordinating and actioning requests initiated by Front End Sales, Portal Administration, and other internal departments through Salesforce and shared inbox channels.
  • Vendor Onboarding & Portal Registration: Manages supplier onboarding requests by completing vendor registration forms, complex client surveys, and portal setup across a diverse range of client-managed procurement platforms (e.g., SAP Ariba, Coupa, Jaggaer, Oracle, GEP, risk assessment and management platforms, and others). Serves as the Super User/Portal Administrator.
  • Corporate Structure & Information Governance Applies comprehensive knowledge of ABB's corporate hierarchy and parent-subsidiary relationships to accurately distinguish client inquiries between ABB Inc., ABB Ltd., and subsidiary entities. Determines what corporate structure and ownership information is appropriate to share while maintaining confidentiality of sensitive organizational mapping, ensuring all client-facing communications reflect ABB's actual legal entity relationships with precision and compliance intent.
  • Inbox & Communication Management: Monitors and actions multiple shared inboxes including portal administration notifications, purchase order routing (x2), and case management, in addition to individual inbox management.
  • ELSE-Advisory Operator: Receive and resolve Client inquiries through TalkDesk via ELSE-Advisory Support Line - handling approximately 4-6 occasional calls per day.
  • Supplier Profile Accuracy & Compliance: Maintains an active, accurate, and compliant supplier presence across all client procurement systems. Ensures ABB Inc. is consistently and correctly represented in alignment with ABB's Code of Conduct, and that no unauthorized or duplicate platform registrations (e.g., duplicate ANIDs in SAP Ariba) create compliance risk, subscription cost exposure, or revenue disruption.
  • Access & User Management: Manages user access across all administered platforms, including granting access to Front End Sales Representatives, Accounting, Contracts, Cyber and Data Specialist. Ensures continuity of platform access during organizational transitions or role changes, preventing loss of client connections that may impact revenue.
  • Issue Identification & Resolution: Identifies and resolves platform access errors, registration conflicts, duplicate accounts, and routing issues that may impact transaction processing or delay operational workflows. Partners with Accounting and Finance colleagues to troubleshoot purchase order and invoicing discrepancies.
  • Client Survey & Questionnaire Coordination: Interprets and completes complex client-required questionnaires and vendor surveys, drawing from an internal knowledge base and coordinating with subject matter experts (HSE, Legal, Risk Management, Cyber/Data/Security, Integrity, and Sustainability) for review and authorization signatures when required. Sends completed drafts to subject matter experts for affirmation rather than burdening them with raw completion, maintaining efficiency while ensuring accuracy and accountability.
  • Insurance Certificate & Compliance Documentation: Coordinates with Risk Management to obtain and upload required insurance certificates and compliance documentation to client portals. Manages platform-specific requirements (e.g., Avetta, ISN) and ensures appropriate documentation is provided based on client agreement status.
  • Cross-Divisional Collaboration & Escalation: Partners with colleagues across ELSE-Advisory Services, and other ABB divisions to address shared client platform conflicts, resolve ANID discrepancies, and establish best practices. Escalates appropriately to Legal, Contracts, or Management when authorization signature or subject matter expertise is required. Collaborates to improve cross-divisional supplier registration process.
  • Policy & Acknowledgement Authorization: Executesclient policy acknowledgements and compliance confirmations on behalf of ABB Inc. when signature authorization is not required, while appropriately routing documents requiring legal review or executive authorization to the correct departments. This distinction reduces process delays while maintaining integrity and compliance.
  • Client-Facing Communication & Sales Support: Provides clear, professional client-facing communication including status updates and platform alignment discussions. Supports Front End Sales on client calls to ensure clarity around onboarding, supplier profile updates, and platform-related matters: always representing ABB Inc. with consistency and professionalism.
  • Documentation, Audit Readiness & Process Standardization: Ensures all vendor registration documentation is accurately recorded, organized, and maintained to support historical tracking and audit readiness. Contributes to ISO-aligned process documentation designed for scalability, succession planning, and potential expansion to additional ABB divisions.
  • ViewPoint Access Support: Assists in user access, site and region creation as needed.
  • Performance Monitoring & Continuous Improvement: Tracks request volume, trends, and resolution patterns. Identifies process improvement opportunities, monitors risks, and communicates findings to management. Supports the ongoing business case for formalizing and expanding the Vendor Enablement function within ABB.

Your Background:

  • High School Diploma/GED required + Bachelor’s degree OR equivalent years of experience.
  • 2+ years of experience in a similar Sales role.
  • Good understanding of sales operations in electrification services.
  • Good understanding of the customer’s problems needs and challenges as well as industry-specific knowledge preferred.
  • Effective communication & interpersonal skills with great negotiation and influencing skills.

What's in it for you

We want you to bring your full self to work—your ideas, your energy, your ambition. You’ll have the tools and freedom to grow your skills, shape your path, and take on challenges that matter. Here, your work creates impact you can see and feel, every day.

Join Clario, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific and help build the intelligent quality engineering solutions that support enterprise clinical trial technology. As a Senior Engineer, R&D Software Quality, you will lead the design and development of scalable test automation for a microservices-based platform, with a core focus on using artificial intelligence to improve test coverage, efficiency, and insight. Working closely with Product Management, Software Development, DevOps, and Quality Engineering teams, you will shape testing strategy, solve complex technical challenges, and help deliver reliable, high-quality software that supports clinical research worldwide.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation and incentives.

  • Private medical coverage and MetLife protection.

  • SZÉP Card and telework reimbursement.

  • Flexible time off.

  • Engaging employee events and hybrid technology support.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Serve as a senior technical contributor within the Software Quality Engineering team.

  • Review product requirements and engineering specifications to define test strategies, scope testing effort, and identify quality risks.

  • Create detailed test plans combining manual testing, automated validation, and risk-based coverage.

  • Architect, develop, and maintain automation frameworks, scripts, and libraries for web, application programming interface, and mobile applications.

  • Apply AI-assisted approaches to test design, script development, failure analysis, maintenance, and quality improvement.

  • Establish repeatable testing methods that support parallel product development and automation delivery.

  • Test microservices-based solutions through functional, integration, system, regression, and end-to-end testing.

  • Troubleshoot failures by analyzing application logs, test environments, service behavior, and database results using SQL.

  • Collaborate with software developers, system administrators, database administrators, Product Management, and DevOps teams to resolve quality issues.

  • Maintain test cases, requirements traceability, execution evidence, and defects within test management tools.

  • Review automation and testing work completed by less experienced engineers, providing technical guidance, training, and constructive feedback.

  • Identify root causes of quality problems and drive corrective actions through completion.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement of testing tools, automation practices, development processes, and team standards.

  • Communicate quality status, risks, findings, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What We Look For

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Minimum 5 years of software quality engineering or software testing experience.

  • Strong experience designing and maintaining automated tests for web, API, or mobile applications.

  • Proficiency with JavaScript, SQL, and automation tools such as Selenium, Katalon, Playwright, or comparable technologies.

  • Practical understanding of AI-assisted software testing, automation development, or quality analysis.

  • Strong knowledge of the software development lifecycle and functional, integration, system, and regression testing techniques.

  • Experience working directly with software developers to investigate and resolve complex test failures.

  • Familiarity with test and defect management platforms; Polarion experience is advantageous.

  • Experience with Agile development practices; knowledge of Scaled Agile Framework practices is advantageous.

  • Familiarity with DevOps practices, cloud-based solutions, microservices, and regulated software environments is preferred.

  • Knowledge of 21 CFR Part 11 and current Good Practice requirements is advantageous.

  • Strong analytical, mentoring, communication, and problem-solving capabilities.

  • Professional fluency in English.

  • Ability to travel occasionally, if required.

At Clario, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, our purpose is to transform lives by unlocking better evidence. It’s a cause that unites and inspires us. Whether you're advancing clinical science, building innovative technology, or supporting our global teams, your work helps bring life-changing therapies to patients faster.

We have conviction and we strive to live our values every day. We want our people to do what they truly love amongst a team of highly talented (but humble) peers.
